title: Digital Marketing & Lead Generation Virtual Assistant
description:
# Digital Marketing & Lead Generation Specialist (Virtual Assistant)

**Full-Time | Work From Home | Australian Business | Long-Term Opportunity**



### About the Company



ReSmile is a new Australian dental concierge brand preparing to launch into the Australian market.



We help people interested in improving their smiles connect with suitable dental clinics and professionals through a personalised concierge service.



Our goal is to make exploring smile transformations and dental treatment options easier, more accessible and less overwhelming.



We connect prospective patients with our network of affiliated dental clinics, help organise consultations and provide support throughout their initial journey.



We are building a modern, professional and approachable brand, and we are looking for an experienced Digital Marketing & Lead Generation Specialist to help us launch and grow.



This is an exciting opportunity to join a brand from the beginning and play an important role in its success.



### The Role



We are looking for an experienced, creative and highly reliable Virtual Assistant who specialises in digital marketing, social media management and paid advertising.



Your primary responsibility will be to build ReSmile's online presence, establish brand awareness and trust, and generate genuine prospective patient enquiries.



**This is NOT just a social media posting job.**



We need someone who understands how to market a brand, create engaging content, manage advertising campaigns and turn an audience into actual business enquiries.



There are three key priorities:



1. **Brand Awareness:** Get ReSmile in front of the right Australian audience and establish a recognisable brand.

2. **Brand Trust:** Create professional, educational and engaging content that builds credibility and encourages people to feel comfortable contacting us.

3. **Lead Generation:** Develop and manage advertising campaigns that generate genuine patient enquiries and consultation bookings.



### Key Responsibilities



**1.
 & Instagram Management**

- Manage ReSmile's
 and Instagram accounts.

- Plan and maintain monthly content calendars.

- Create and schedule regular organic posts.

- Develop Instagram Reels, Stories and carousel posts.

- Write engaging captions and marketing copy.

- Monitor comments, messages and engagement.

- Grow our audience and build an active online community.

- Maintain consistent branding and messaging.



**2. Content Creation**

- Create professional and engaging social media graphics using Canva.

- Produce and edit short-form videos and Reels.

- Develop educational content about ReSmile and what we offer.

- Create promotional content and launch campaigns.

- Research content trends relevant to Australian audiences.

- Develop creative ideas that increase engagement and brand awareness.

- Repurpose content across different social media platforms.



**3. Meta Advertising 
 & Instagram Ads)**

- Set up and manage campaigns through Meta Ads Manager.

- Develop paid advertising strategies targeting Australian audiences.

- Create advertising graphics, videos and copy.

- Build lead generation campaigns.

- Test different audiences, creatives and messaging.

- Monitor advertising spend and campaign performance.

- Optimise campaigns to improve results and reduce cost per lead.

- Report on campaign performance and recommend improvements.



**4. Lead Generation**

This is one of the most important responsibilities of the role.



- Develop strategies to generate genuine prospective patient enquiries.

- Create campaigns that encourage people to enquire about ReSmile.

- Manage
 and Instagram lead generation campaigns.

- Identify the right audiences for our services.

- Monitor enquiry volumes and cost per lead.

- Review lead quality and identify opportunities to improve conversion.

- Develop new strategies to increase enquiries and consultation bookings.



Our goal is not simply to gain followers or likes. We want marketing that generates real business opportunities.



**5. Brand Growth & Marketing Strategy**

- Research competitors and the Australian dental and cosmetic dentistry market.

- Identify opportunities to increase brand awareness.

- Develop new marketing ideas and campaigns.

- Help establish ReSmile as a trusted and recognisable brand.

- Take initiative and recommend improvements.

- Contribute to the ongoing growth of the business.



### Required Experience



Applicants MUST have practical experience in:



-
 and Instagram business account management.

- Organic social media marketing.

- Content creation and Canva.

- Instagram Reels and video editing.

- Meta Business Suite.

- Meta Ads Manager.

- Creating and managing paid advertising campaigns.

-
 and Instagram lead generation.

- Understanding advertising metrics, campaign optimisation and cost per lead.

- Writing professional English marketing content.



**Highly regarded:**

- Experience marketing to Australian audiences.

- Experience in dental, healthcare, cosmetic dentistry, beauty or lifestyle industries.

- Experience launching a new brand.

- Experience managing campaigns with measurable lead generation results.



### The Person We Are Looking For



Reliability and results are extremely important to us.



We want someone who is:



- Highly reliable and dependable.

- Proactive and able to work independently.

- Creative and confident bringing new ideas.

- Organised and consistent.

- Results-driven and commercially minded.

- Comfortable taking ownership of their responsibilities.

- Excellent at communicating and meeting deadlines.

- Interested in growing with a business long-term.



We do not want someone who needs to be constantly reminded what to do. We want someone who takes responsibility, identifies what needs to be done and gets on with it.



### Performance Expectations



You will be measured on the quality and consistency of your work, as well as marketing outcomes.



Key performance indicators include:

- Consistent social media content delivery.

- Growth in brand awareness and audience reach.

- Growth in relevant followers and engagement.

- Quality of content and brand presentation.

- Successful management of paid advertising campaigns.

- Number of genuine enquiries generated.

This is an opportunity to be part of a new Australian brand from the beginning.



You will have the opportunity to contribute ideas, develop marketing strategies and play an important role in building the brand.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with the business and takes genuine pride in delivering results.



**We want someone who knows how to build a brand, earn an audience's trust and turn marketing into enquiries.**



If this sounds like you, we would love to hear from you.

title: Marketing Recruiter & Business Support
description:
Marketing Recruiter & Business Support (Digital Marketing & Creative Recruiting)

Remote | Full-time | 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern | Fluent English required



About TopFoxx

TopFoxx is a women-owned NYC eyewear brand, growing fast, building luxury sunglasses that solve real problems: floating sunnies, tangle-free aviators, foldable pocket frames, and mood-boosting lenses. We are a small team and a small business, not corporate at all, and it is a fun brand to be part of. We are close-knit and supportive, and everyone here wears many hats and jumps in wherever they are needed.



Our biggest opportunity right now is building an exceptional marketing team. We believe that great companies are built by great people, and finding those people is one of the highest-impact jobs in the company. We are looking for someone who loves recruiting, understands digital marketing (to ask very detailed skill based questions), and gets excited about finding the people who will help TopFoxx grow for years to come.



The Role

This is not a traditional HR recruiter position, and it is not simply posting jobs and scheduling interviews. Your job is to build a world-class marketing team.



You will own the recruiting process for our marketing and creative departments, partnering directly with leadership to understand every role, identify exceptional talent, and hire people who can make a measurable impact on our business.



We are looking for someone who understands marketing well enough to recognize great marketers. You don't need to be the person running Meta Ads or creating videos yourself, but you should understand what separates an average candidate from an exceptional one.



The 80/20 Structure

This role is expected to be approximately:

- 80% Recruiting & Talent AcquisitionYour primary focus will always be finding, evaluating, and helping us hire exceptional people, particularly across marketing, creative, e-commerce, and growth roles.

- 20% Marketing, HR, Project & Business SupportWe're a lean and growing company, so when recruiting volume is lighter or another priority needs additional support, you'll have the opportunity to contribute beyond recruiting.



Depending on your strengths and current company priorities, this could include supporting marketing-related projects, research, project coordination, HR initiatives, documentation, process improvement, team engagement, administrative projects, or other cross-functional business needs.



We're looking for someone who enjoys recruiting but is also curious, adaptable, and willing to jump into new challenges when they can make an impact.



What Success Looks Like

You are successful when TopFoxx consistently hires exceptional marketing talent that helps the business grow.



Day to day, that means you:

- Build strong pipelines before hiring becomes urgent.

- Fill marketing positions quickly without sacrificing quality.

- Identify candidates who demonstrate ownership, problem-solving, communication, and execution.

- Create an excellent candidate experience from first contact through onboarding.

- Support new team members during their first month by helping them integrate into the company and successfully transition into their role.

- Help onboard team members by sharing bonus plans, setting clear KPIs, and ensuring they understand how success will be measured.

- Proactively source top talent from other companies through LinkedIn and other professional networks.

- Continuously improve our recruiting process so hiring becomes faster, more consistent, and more data-driven.

- Keep recruiting organized with accurate trackers, interview notes, scorecards, bonus plans and documentation.



What You'll Recruit For

You'll primarily recruit for marketing and creative positions, including:

- Paid Media: Meta Ads Specialists, TikTok Ads Specialists & Performance Marketing Managers

- Creative: Video Editors, Creative Strategists, Graphic Designers & UGC Creators

- Lifecycle Marketing:
 Marketing & SMS Marketing Specialists, Digital marketing specialists

- E-commerce Marketing: Growth Marketing Specialists, Shopify Marketing, Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)

- Partnerships: Affiliate Marketing Managers & Influencer Marketing ManagersSales: Wholesale Sales Representatives & E-commerce Sales Professionals



As TopFoxx grows, you'll also help recruit future marketing leadership positions.



What You'll Oversee (Key Responsibilities)



1) Full-Cycle Recruiting

- Own the complete recruitment process from intake meeting through offer acceptance.

- Partner with hiring managers to fully understand each position before recruiting begins.

- Write compelling, high-converting job advertisements.

- Post jobs across multiple recruiting platforms.

- Source passive candidates through LinkedIn and other channels.

- Build talent pipelines for future hiring needs.

- Review resumes, portfolios, and applications.

- Conduct structured interviews.

- Coordinate interviews with hiring managers and leadership.

- Perform reference checks when appropriate.

- Keep candidates informed throughout the hiring process.

- Present hiring recommendations supported by structured evaluations.



2) Candidate Evaluation

- Evaluate candidates based on real ability, ownership, communication, and execution, not resumes alone.

- Review portfolios, case studies, assessments, and work samples.

- Identify high performers who align with TopFoxx's culture and expectations.

- Build structured interview scorecards for every role.

- Develop role-specific interview questions.

- Recommend assessments that accurately measure job performance.



3) Recruiting Systems & Process Improvement

- Build and improve recruiting workflows.

- Create hiring playbooks and recruiting SOPs.

- Maintain recruiting dashboards and hiring trackers.

- Improve interview processes and candidate evaluation systems.

- Keep recruiting documentation organized and up to date.

- Continuously recommend ways to improve hiring quality and efficiency.



4) Partnership With Leadership

- Meet regularly with hiring managers to understand hiring priorities.

- Help define ideal candidate profiles before recruiting begins.

- Ensure every position has clear expectations and measurable success criteria.

- Keep leadership updated on recruiting progress, hiring challenges, and pipeline health.

- Recommend improvements to job descriptions, compensation, interview processes, and recruiting strategy when appropriate.



5) Employer Branding & Candidate Experience

- Represent TopFoxx professionally throughout the hiring process.

- Write engaging candidate outreach messages.

- Ensure every candidate has a positive experience, regardless of hiring outcome.

- Help strengthen TopFoxx's reputation as an employer of choice.



6) Onboarding Support

- Assisting with onboarding, employee experience, and company culture initiatives.

- Helping coordinate cross-functional projects.

- Ensure candidates receive the information, tools, and documentation needed before their first day.

- Partner with hiring managers to help new hires transition successfully into their roles.



7) Additional Support & Cross-Functional ProjectsWhen recruiting needs are lighter, or as business needs evolve, you may also support other areas of the company based on your skills and priorities. This may include:

- Supporting project management and cross-functional projects when additional help is needed.

- Supporting other operational or organizational projects as the company grows.

- Helping coordinate marketing projects and follow-ups.

- Supporting special projects from marketing leadership or the Founder.

- Helping create or improve SOPs and internal processes.

- Supporting HR and administrative projects.

- Researching solutions to business or operational problems.

- Taking ownership of other projects where your skills can help the company move faster.



This role is primarily focused on recruiting, but as TopFoxx continues to grow, there may be opportunities to develop your skills and take on additional responsibilities in areas where you can make a meaningful impact.



What We're Looking For

Must-haves:

- 2+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience.

- Experience recruiting digital marketing, creative, e-commerce, or startup positions.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong interviewing and candidate evaluation skills.

- Experience managing multiple open positions simultaneously.

- Exceptional organization and follow-through.

- Strong ownership mindset, you proactively solve problems instead of waiting for direction.

- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

- Must have a growth mindset, developing your skills and solving hardest problems. 



Nice to have:

- LinkedIn Recruiter

- Indeed

- OnlineJobs.ph

- Google Workspace

- Asana

- AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude

- Startup or e-commerce experience

- Experience building recruiting scorecards, interview guides, assessments, or hiring SOPs



As a fully remote team, TopFoxx uses Time Doctor during working hours for international team members. Time Doctor is a time-tracking and productivity tool that records hours worked and takes periodic screenshots while the timer is running. For this full-time role, it is used to verify and track the expected 8-hour workday.

Kingdom Key Business Operating Systems (KKBOS)

Kingdom Key Business Operating Systems helps businesses strengthen their operations through technology, organized workflows, automation, staffing support, and business systems. We help business owners identify where they need support and put practical solutions in place so they can serve their clients and grow with greater confidence.



Position Summary



The Client Success and Support Specialist helps KKBOS clients use their systems effectively and receive timely, professional support. This role supports client communication, onboarding, training coordination, and follow-up. The specialist also assists with sales activities and recruiting tasks to help the team manage leads, candidates, and daily operations.



The ideal candidate is organized, responsive, comfortable learning technology, and able to communicate with professionalism and care.

Client Success and System Support



* Respond to client questions through approved communication channels in a timely and professional manner.

* Help clients navigate and use their KKBOS systems, portals, workflows, and available features.

* Support client onboarding by coordinating setup steps, gathering information, and tracking outstanding items.

* Schedule training sessions, demonstrations, check-ins, and follow-up meetings.

* Document client questions, requests, progress, and next steps in the appropriate system.

* Identify recurring issues and share clear feedback with the team so client support and system instructions can improve.

* Escalate technical issues, account concerns, or requests outside the role’s authority to the appropriate team member.

* Maintain a helpful, patient, and solutions-focused approach in every client interaction.



Sales Support



* Assist with lead follow-up by sending approved messages, making calls, and tracking responses.

* Help schedule sales calls, consultations, and product demonstrations.

* Prepare or organize approved sales materials, client information, proposals, and follow-up reminders.

* Update lead and sales activity in the CRM or other designated KKBOS system.

* Support the sales team with prospect research and basic information gathering.

* Follow approved scripts and messaging, and refer pricing, contract, or service questions to the appropriate team member.

* Keep sales records accurate and help ensure prospects receive timely follow-up.



Recruiting Support



* Assist with posting job opportunities on approved platforms.

* Review applications for completeness and organize candidate information.

* Contact candidates using approved communication templates and help schedule interviews.

* Track candidate progress through the recruiting process and update the appropriate system.

* Assist with collecting onboarding documents and coordinating next steps for selected candidates.

* Communicate professionally with applicants and protect confidential candidate information.

* Refer candidate questions about pay, employment terms, or client assignments to the appropriate team member.



Administrative and Team Support



* Maintain accurate records, task lists, calendars, and follow-up reminders.

* Help prepare reports on client support, sales activity, and recruiting progress.

* Follow company procedures for handling client, prospect, and candidate information.

* Participate in team meetings, training sessions, and performance check-ins.

* Complete other related duties that support KKBOS clients and daily operations.



Qualifications



* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

* Customer service experience, preferably supporting business clients.

* Comfort learning web-based platforms, CRMs, scheduling tools, and business systems.

* Strong organization, attention to detail, and follow-through.

* Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.

* Professional, patient, and respectful communication style.

* Ability to handle confidential information responsibly.

* Prior experience in sales support, recruiting coordination, home care, healthcare, or business operations is an asset.



What Success Looks Like



* Clients receive timely, courteous, and reliable support.

* Client requests and follow-up tasks are documented and completed accurately.

* Leads receive consistent follow-up and sales activity is recorded.

* Candidates move through the recruiting process in an organized and respectful manner.

* The team has clear updates and dependable administrative support.



How to Apply



Please submit your résumé and a brief video introduction describing your customer support, technology, sales support, or recruiting experience. Also, an iPhone is required and strong English communication skills.

title: Part-Time Social Media & Creator Outreach Assistant (Remote, Long-Term)
description:
About us



We're a small US brand that sells research peptides for laboratory research use only. Our products are not for human consumption, and everything we publish follows that rule. We're looking for a careful, organized assistant to grow the brand through organic content, creator partnerships and community participation.



What you'll do:



• Schedule and post short-form videos and posts on Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts and X, from content we provide or approve, using our scheduling tool with your own login

• Find micro-creators (5,000–50,000 followers) in fitness, longevity, biohacking and science, and invite them to our affiliate program with short, personal messages

• Represent our brand openly in online communities where brands are welcome: our own Discord, X, and Reddit only where a community's rules allow vendors. Answer questions about orders, shipping and our lab test certificates (COAs)

• Log every contact, reply and partner in our shared tracker, and send a short weekly report

Compliance rules (non-negotiable)

• Never give dosage, usage, mixing, injection, "stacking" or "protocol" advice, and never discuss use in people or animals. If anyone asks, send our approved reply and pass the conversation to us

• Never use medical or health-benefit language, such as treat, cure, heal, recovery, weight loss or anti-aging

• Always say you represent the brand. No fake accounts, fake reviews or vote manipulation, and no posting where a community's rules forbid brands or sales

• Creators we partner with must label their posts as ads and follow the same rules

• No mass messaging: personal messages only, one follow-up at most, and stop when someone says no



What we're looking for:



• Excellent written English

• At least 1 year of social media management or influencer outreach; health, wellness or supplement brands are a plus

• Strong attention to detail and comfort following written guidelines exactly

• 15–20 hours a week, with at least 2 hours overlapping 9 AM–5 PM US Central time



Pay and process

• Hourly base pay, paid weekly for completed work, plus a bonus for every creator partner who goes live

• A short paid trial task before hiring

• A long-term role for the right person



How to apply

Answer these two questions in your cover letter:

1. Share an account or campaign you grew organically, and what you did to grow it.

2. Someone messages our brand asking how much they should take. In one or two sentences, what do you reply?

To prove you read this entire post and have high attention to detail, please start your cover letter with the exact phrase: I am ready to scale TrueP USA.

title: Supply Chain Manager (Shopify/E-commerce)
description:
We are looking for an experienced Supply Chain & E-commerce Operations Specialist to join our growing e-commerce team.



This is a hands-on operational role. You will be responsible for monitoring orders from purchase through delivery, identifying fulfillment issues before they become bigger problems, coordinating with suppliers and Customer Support, and making sure our Shopify backend and operational data remain accurate.



We are specifically looking for someone who already has experience working with Shopify and e-commerce operations and understands how orders, fulfillment, refunds, subscriptions, tracking and suppliers work together.



Your daily responsibilities will include:

- Monitoring Shopify orders and fulfillment statuses

- Identifying aging, delayed and problematic orders

- Monitoring open orders and shipment exceptions

- Tracking shipments through tools such as Parcel Panel, 17TRACK and carrier websites

- Investigating failed deliveries, returned-to-sender shipments, missed pickups and address issues

- Coordinating with suppliers and fulfillment partners to resolve order issues

- Monitoring supplier-raised concerns and following up until resolved

- Reviewing and validating refunds and cancelled orders

- Checking that refunds, cancellations and fulfillment statuses are correctly reflected in Shopify

- Monitoring subscription-related order issues

- Coordinating with Customer Support on cancellations, refunds, subscriptions and delivery problems

- Reviewing COGS and validating costs against Shopify orders

- Identifying incorrect quantities, costs or order information

- Reviewing chargebacks and disputes against existing orders

- Maintaining internal supply chain trackers and keeping case statuses accurate

- Preparing and exporting shipment/order data when required

- Proactively identifying operational problems instead of waiting for customers to complain

- Escalating unresolved issues to the appropriate team member, supplier or fulfillment partner



What we're looking for:

- Previous experience in e-commerce operations, supply chain, fulfillment or order management

- Strong hands-on experience with Shopify

- Experience handling a high volume of e-commerce orders

- Understanding of order fulfillment from purchase to final delivery

- Experience working with suppliers, warehouses or 3PL/fulfillment partners

- Experience with shipment tracking and delivery exceptions

- Understanding of refunds, cancellations, chargebacks and subscriptions

- Strong attention to detail

- Good spreadsheet skills

- Strong written English

- Ability to investigate discrepancies independently

- Ability to follow SOPs while using common sense when something does not look right

- Strong ownership mentality and reliable follow-up

- Experience with Parcel Panel, 17TRACK, subscription platforms, PayPal disputes or similar tools is a strong plus.



What success looks like:

We don't want someone who simply checks tasks off a list.



A strong person in this role notices when an order has been stuck for too long, catches mismatched costs or statuses, follows up with suppliers without being reminded, makes sure refunds and cancellations are actually completed, and keeps Customer Support informed when action is required.



You should be comfortable working independently and taking ownership of an issue until it is resolved.



To apply



Please send us:

- A short introduction about yourself

- Your previous e-commerce or supply chain experience

- How long you have worked with Shopify

- Which fulfillment, tracking and subscription tools you have used

- An example of an operational or fulfillment problem you identified and solved

- Your current availability

- Your expected monthly salary



Please start your application with the word “SHOPIFY” so we know you have read the full job description.

title: Creator Platform Ops Manager
description:
The Creator Platform Ops Manager is the business owner of the MAG Creator Platform, My Amazon Guy’s proprietary system for managing user-generated content (UGC) and affiliate partnerships across 400+ brands.



As the point leader for creator partnerships and affiliate-driven growth, the Manager will establish scalable workflows for onboarding, compliance, content approvals, payments, and reporting. In addition to leading the operations team, they will actively pitch the MAG Creator Platform to prospective and existing clients and communicate the value of its services. By building strong creator relationships, ensuring campaign excellence, and driving platform adoption, they will contribute to revenue growth and elevate content quality across the portfolio.



Key Responsibilities:

- Serve as the primary business owner for the MAG Creator Platform, partnering with Lead Developer to guide roadmap priorities.

- Monitor platform adoption, usability, and ROI across 400+ brands.

- Design and implement the end-to-end creator lifecycle: discovery, onboarding, proposals, approvals, content delivery, and payments.

- Develop standards for creator quality, performance scoring, and tiering.

- Build and nurture long-term relationships with top creators and affiliates.

- Create guidelines for brand compliance, FTC disclosures, and usage rights.

- Oversee all campaigns run through the platform: product seeding, UGC packages, sponsored posts, giveaways, and affiliate programs.

- Manage affiliate structures (codes, attribution links, commissions) and ensure tracking integrity.

- Monitor dashboards for platform KPIs: creator participation, campaign ROI, content approval rates, affiliate revenue, etc.

- Work closely with Lead Developer on feature builds, bug fixes, and integrations; Creative Strategists for ad briefs and content quality feedback; Brand Managers to align UGC and affiliate efforts with brand goals.



Qualifications:

• 5+ years in influencer marketing, creator partnerships, affiliate management, or UGC operations (agency or brand side)

• Proven success owning programs or products end-to-end — from roadmap to ops

• Deep understanding of UGC, affiliate programs, and social media ecosystems (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube)

• Comfort with analytics dashboards and data-driven decision

• Experience managing or collaborating with developers on SaaS or internal tools

• Strong leadership: able to hire, mentor, and scale a high-performing operations team

• Excellent communication, project management, and stakeholder alignment skills

• Nice to Have: Experience with Amazon Attribution or marketplace integrations, familiarity with affiliate tracking systems, coupon codes, or influencer SaaS, knowledge of compliance requirements for influencer marketing (FTC, GDPR)



What We Offer:

• Competitive salary base

• Permanent remote setup

• Opportunities for professional development and career advancement

title: Talent Coordinator | Influencer Marketing & Brand Partnerships
description:
Talent Coordinator | Influencer Marketing & Brand Partnerships



Company: Lucious Talent

Website: 

Location: Remote — Philippines

Employment Type: Full-Time Freelance / Independent Contractor

Monthly Compensation: $200–$250 USD + Performance-Based Commission

Working Schedule: Monday–Friday, 1:00 PM–9:00 PM Eastern Time (New York, USA)

Hours: 40 hours per week

Payment Method: Wise (Preferred) / GCash (Alternative)



⸻



About Lucious Talent



Lucious Talent is a growing talent management agency specializing in beauty, fashion, and lifestyle content creators and influencers.



We represent digital creators and help them secure paid brand partnerships, build professional relationships with brands, and develop long-term opportunities within the influencer marketing industry.



Our agency operates through its official online presence at 
, with our team handling day-to-day brand and partnership correspondence through our Lucious Talent business
, accessible at 
 
.



We are currently expanding our team and looking for a second reliable, detail-oriented, and proactive Talent Coordinator to work alongside our existing Talent Coordinator, AJ.



This is an opportunity to join a growing agency, work directly with an established talent coordination team, and contribute to the development and commercial success of our creator roster.



Position Overview



The Talent Coordinator will support the agency’s daily operations, primarily focusing on brand outreach, pitching, follow-ups, campaign coordination, and administrative organization.



You will work collaboratively with our existing Talent Coordinator, AJ, and report to the Founder & Head of Talent.



We are looking for someone who can manage assigned responsibilities independently, communicate effectively with international brands, and maintain consistent productivity throughout their scheduled working hours.



This position requires someone who takes initiative rather than waiting for instructions for every individual task.



Key Responsibilities



1. Brand Outreach & Partnership Pitching



* Research and identify brands that align with our creators’ niches, audiences, aesthetics, and interests.

* Pitch creators to beauty, skincare, cosmetics, fashion, clothing, accessories, footwear, lifestyle, and other relevant brands.

* Contact brand representatives, influencer marketing managers, PR agencies, and partnership departments.

* Prepare and send professional, personalized brand outreach
s.

* Conduct follow-ups with brands according to assigned outreach schedules.

* Maintain accurate records of all pitches, responses, and potential opportunities.

* Identify opportunities for paid collaborations, events, PR campaigns, gifting, and other relevant partnerships.

* Prioritize paid collaborations while identifying worthwhile opportunities for our creators.



2.
 & Inbox Management



* Organize creator-specific
 accounts.

* Maintain appropriate
 labels and folders.

* Categorize brand responses, partnership inquiries, affiliate opportunities, invoices, contracts, and campaign correspondence.

* Monitor incoming
s and promptly identify important brand responses.

* Keep inboxes organized and ensure no important partnership opportunities are overlooked.

* Maintain monthly pitching and outreach organization.



3. Campaign & Partnership Coordination



* Track ongoing brand campaigns and partnership deadlines.

* Assist with campaign scheduling and creator calendars.

* Monitor deliverables, posting deadlines, campaign requirements, and follow-up obligations.

* Request campaign briefs, budgets, timelines, and licensing information from brands when necessary.

* Communicate important campaign updates to the Founder & Head of Talent.

* Assist with coordinating creators, editors, and approved vendors.



4. Contract Review & Administrative Support



* Review draft campaign agreements and identify unusual or unfavorable terms.

* Prepare suggested edits and redlines based on agency instructions.

* Flag concerns involving usage rights, licensing, exclusivity, paid advertising, whitelisting, Spark Ads, raw footage, deliverables, and payment terms.

* Organize signed agreements and relevant campaign documentation.

* Assist with maintaining agency records and internal databases.



Important: This position does not have independent authority to accept brand deals, sign contracts, approve final campaign terms, or independently negotiate rates without written authorization.



All final deal approvals and creator representation decisions remain with the Founder & Head of Talent.



5. Team Coordination



* Work directly with the existing Talent Coordinator, AJ.

* Coordinate assigned responsibilities and avoid duplicating outreach.

* Communicate progress, outstanding assignments, and important updates.

* Participate in internal coordination and follow established agency procedures.

* Maintain organized handovers when assignments require collaboration.



Daily Work Schedule & Expectations



The required schedule is:



Monday through Friday



* Start: 1:00 PM Eastern Time (New York, USA).

* End: 9:00 PM Eastern Time (New York, USA).

* Weekly schedule: 40 hours.



Applicants must be able to consistently work according to New York’s Eastern Time, including daylight-saving-time changes.



This is not a flexible-hours position. Applicants must be available during the specified schedule.



Coordinators are expected to complete their assigned daily responsibilities, maintain accurate records, and communicate any outstanding work before the end of their shift.



Assignments must not simply be abandoned or left without an update when the scheduled shift ends. If an urgent task requires additional time, the coordinator must communicate with management and obtain approval for any additional working hours. Any additional work and compensation will be handled in accordance with the agreed arrangement and applicable law.



Performance Expectations & Pitching Standards



We value quality, consistency, and actual results over simply sending large quantities of
s.



Our general outreach planning range is approximately 100–150 targeted opportunities per assigned creator per month, depending on the roster, workload, creator preferences, and available opportunities.



The maximum general planning limit is 200 opportunities per creator per month unless otherwise approved.



We expect:



* Professional and personalized outreach.

* Accurate spelling, grammar, and creator information.

* Appropriate brand and creator matching.

* Consistent follow-ups.

* Proper tracking of outreach.

* Timely responses to brand inquiries.

* Initiative in identifying new partnership opportunities.

* No fabricated analytics, rates, or creator information.



AI Policy



We do not permit AI-generated or AI-assisted brand pitching or outreach.



Every pitch must be individually written, thoughtfully personalized, and reviewed by the coordinator before sending. We want genuine human communication, not generic automated messages.



Compensation & Commission Structure



Monthly Compensation: $200–$250 USD



The final monthly rate will depend on qualifications, relevant experience, communication skills, demonstrated performance, and overall suitability for the position.



Compensation is performance-oriented.



We expect coordinators to consistently complete their responsibilities and demonstrate meaningful contributions to the agency’s pitching and partnership efforts.



Performance reviews may consider:



* Quality and quantity of targeted pitches.

* Successful brand responses and conversions.

* Paid partnerships directly generated through the coordinator’s outreach.

* Consistency of follow-ups.

* Organization and reliability.

* Overall contribution to creator growth and agency operations.



Where performance consistently falls below reasonable expectations, compensation may be reviewed prospectively, with any agreed adjustment documented in writing and subject to applicable law. Earned compensation will not be retroactively reduced.



Additional 5% Commission



Coordinators are eligible to receive an additional 5% of the actual agency commission received from qualifying brand deals they personally source through their original pitches and meaningful follow-up.



For clarity, this is NOT 5% of the creator’s gross campaign payment.



Example:



* Creator’s brand deal: $2,000.

* Agency commission (20%): $400.

* Coordinator’s commission (5% of agency commission): $20.



The bonus is only applicable when the coordinator’s original pitch directly results in a qualifying paid partnership, the creator accepts the opportunity, management approves it, and the agency actually receives its commission.



Gifted-only collaborations, unpaid opportunities, canceled deals, and previously active opportunities do not qualify.



Payment Methods



Our preferred payment method is Wise, as it allows us to maintain organized international payment records and documentation.



We can also accommodate:



* GCash.

* Another mutually agreed payment method in exceptional circumstances.



All payments are denominated in USD, with the agreed receiving method and applicable transaction fees discussed before payment.



Professional Requirements & Confidentiality



Because this position involves access to creator accounts, brand contacts, private campaign information, and agency operations, confidentiality is essential.



The successful applicant must:



* Protect all agency and creator information.

* Never share account credentials or grant unauthorized access.

* Never use creator information or brand contacts for personal business or another agency.

* Never solicit our represented creators for independent representation.

* Never bypass management or redirect agency opportunities.

* Disclose potential conflicts of interest involving other talent agencies or influencer management businesses.

* Follow agency communication and account-security procedures.

* Maintain professional communication with brands, creators, and team members.



This is a non-exclusive freelance opportunity, subject to disclosure of potential conflicts and confidentiality requirements.



Qualifications



Our ideal applicant should have:



1. Excellent written and spoken English.

2. Strong professional
 communication skills.

3. Experience in influencer marketing, virtual assistance, talent coordination, PR, brand outreach, or digital marketing.

4. Familiarity with Gmail and Google Workspace.

5. Strong organizational and time-management skills.

description:

An experienced lead generation specialist who builds a list where every single row is verified.

Not a list of "Amazon sellers". A list I can hand to sales without redoing the work.

Long-term role. Part time or full time, both work.



FIELDS PER LEAD

1. Brand name

2. Amazon US storefront URL

, verified as deliverable

IMPORTANT - RATINGS ARE NOT REVIEWS

The star histogram on a listing shows percentages of RATINGS. Most of those are star-only ratings with no text. We cannot work with those - we need reviews that contain text.

Field 6 therefore means WRITTEN reviews only. You get the real number from the filtered view of the listing (filter by 1 star, then 2 stars, then 3 stars), where Amazon shows "X total ratings, Y with reviews". Y is the number we need. Never calculate it from the percentages.

- Listing is not on

 not verified as deliverable

LINKEDIN

HOW WE START

accepted leads per week.



TOOLS

Your choice. Helium 10, Jungle Scout, SellerSprite, Apollo, Hunter, NeverBounce, Sales Navigator. Tell me what you use and whether you hold your own licences.



TO APPLY - answer these three. Applications without answers are ignored.

Do not send a generic cover letter. The example row is your application.

Apply here on OnlineJobs.ph only. Do NOT
 me personally and do not contact me on any other channel. I only reply to applications sent through this platform - everything else is ignored.

We're Canadian Funding Partners, a Canadian firm that helps businesses get government funding. You'll phone owners of small and mid-size Canadian businesses and book short calls with our specialists about government funding for their business. The leads are fresh, the dialer is fast, and the offer is real. Your job is the phone.



HOURS: Monday to Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Eastern (10:00 p.m. to 6:00 a.m. Philippine time).



WHAT A NORMAL DAY LOOKS LIKE

- 120+ dials on a power dialer

- 4+ hours actually on the phone

- Every missed callback returned within 15 minutes

- One lunch break. No disappearing.



WE TRACK EVERY MINUTE. Every call, every gap, every callback is measured automatically and reviewed every day. We don't micromanage you; we just look at the numbers. If the numbers are there, we leave you alone and you earn.



DON'T APPLY IF

- you can't make 120 calls a day, every day

- rejection gets to you

- you need weeks of training before you're good

- you want a quiet, low-pressure job (this is the opposite)

- your internet or your room isn't reliable



APPLY IF

- you've done at least 1 year of outbound cold calling or appointment setting, ideally B2B to North America

- your spoken English is clear and confident

- you have a quiet room, a noise-cancelling headset, a computer, internet of 25 Mbps or more, and a backup connection

- you can work the hours above, every weekday

- French is a plus, not required



PAY

- PHP 40,000 a month base, paid twice a month. Guaranteed.

- Plus PHP 800 for every meeting you book that is held, rising to PHP 1,000 per meeting after your 40th held meeting in a month. No cap.

- A meeting counts as held when the owner shows up, is qualified (incorporated, 5 or more staff), and is interested in using AI in their business. We confirm this after each meeting.

- Examples only, not a promise (this role has no earnings history yet): 20 held meetings = PHP 56,000; 30 = PHP 64,000; 45 = PHP 77,000 a month.

- Your trial day is paid.



HOW WE HIRE (FAST)

1. You send the application below.

2. We listen to every recording. Shortlisted applicants get a short prep guide and a 15-minute AI calling test (about 12 practice calls that get harder). The best then do a live mock call with us.

3. Those who pass do one paid trial day on real calls.

4. Then we review day by day. Hit the numbers and you stay.



HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY, THIS IS PART OF THE TEST)

 
 with this exact subject line:

Caller – [Your full name] – [Dials per day at your last job]



The first line of your
 must be the word MAPLE.

3. Recording 2: your answer, in your own words, to "I'm busy, just send me an
." (60 seconds max)

title: HubSpot Full Implementation Expert
description:
This is a Full Time Project role and expected to be completed within 2 months.



We are looking for a hands-on HubSpot expert who can also manage the implementation project. You will help onboard our teams, structure our CRM, connect our lead sources and build practical workflows and automation across both markets.



This role requires direct experience implementing HubSpot—not just using it for contact entry or administrative support.



Your Main Objective



Build a reliable, easy-to-use HubSpot system that helps us capture enquiries, assign leads to the right salesperson, follow up consistently, track sales opportunities and measure results across Singapore and Malaysia.



Our intended lead journey includes:



Paid advertising → Shopify enquiry forms → HubSpot → Sales assignment → Follow-up and nurturing → Sales conversion → Reporting



Key Responsibilities



1. Implementation Planning and Project Management



Review our existing HubSpot setup, sales processes, lead sources and business requirements.



Develop an implementation roadmap with clear priorities, milestones, responsibilities and timelines.



Coordinate with management, marketing, e-commerce and sales teams across both countries.



Maintain a project tracker and provide weekly updates on progress, outstanding decisions and blockers.



Recommend practical solutions that work within our subscribed HubSpot plans and budget.



2. CRM Setup and Data Organisation



Configure HubSpot Marketing Hub and Sales Hub, including relevant Professional-tier features available under our subscriptions.



Set up contact, company and deal properties, lifecycle stages, lead statuses, pipelines and ownership rules.



Organise records by country, business channel, product interest and customer type.



Clean, deduplicate and import existing data where required.



Configure appropriate user access and document clear data-entry standards.



3. Lead Capture and Integrations



Connect Shopify enquiry forms and relevant lead sources to HubSpot.



Ensure enquiries capture the information needed for sales follow-up and reporting.



Set up lead-source and campaign tracking where supported.



Configure lead routing by country, enquiry type, product category or assigned salesperson.



Assess native integrations first and identify any need for tools such as Zapier or Make, including associated costs.



4. Workflows and Automation



Build and test workflows for lead assignment, internal notifications and follow-up tasks.



Set up acknowledgement
s, nurturing journeys and re-engagement campaigns where appropriate.



Implement reminders and escalation rules for uncontacted leads and stalled opportunities.



Configure sales sequences where supported and appropriate to the team’s process.



Apply suitable consent checks, suppression rules and safeguards against duplicate or inappropriate messages.



5. Reporting and Visibility



Create dashboards showing lead volume, lead sources, assignment and follow-up activity, pipeline progress and sales conversion.



Provide separate Singapore and Malaysia reporting, alongside a consolidated management view.



Help management identify missed follow-ups, pipeline bottlenecks and opportunities to improve performance.



6. Testing, Training and Handover



Test the complete lead journey before launch, including routing, notifications, automation and reporting.



Resolve issues and support users during rollout.



Produce clear SOPs, workflow documentation and short video tutorials.



Train our teams to use and maintain the system confidently.



Provide ongoing optimisation and troubleshooting if the engagement is extended.



Required Experience and Skills



Proven hands-on experience implementing HubSpot Marketing Hub and Sales Hub.



Experience building workflows, sales pipelines, lead-routing rules, dashboards and CRM data structures.



Ability to manage a project independently, from requirements gathering through setup, testing, training and handover.



Experience connecting websites or e-commerce platforms to HubSpot; Shopify experience is strongly preferred.



Strong understanding of lead management, sales follow-up and marketing automation.

title: PROFESSIONAL WEDDING FILM EDITOR

**Company:** My Wedding Media  

**Position:** Senior Wedding Film Editor  

**Location:** Remote – Philippines  

**Job Type:** Freelance / Project-Based (Long-Term Opportunity)  

**Experience:** Minimum 5 Years



## About My Wedding Media



My Wedding Media is a professional wedding photography and filmmaking company dedicated to creating cinematic, emotional, and timeless wedding films.



We believe every wedding tells a unique story, and our goal is to capture those moments through beautiful visuals, intentional storytelling, and exceptional editing.



We are seeking a **highly experienced, creative, and detail-oriented Wedding Film Editor** to join our growing team.



The ideal candidate has a strong background in wedding filmmaking, an exceptional artistic eye, and the ability to transform raw footage into emotionally compelling cinematic films.



You will work directly under our **Creative Director**, collaborating on multiple wedding film projects while maintaining our company's creative standards and visual identity.



## Key Responsibilities



- Edit cinematic wedding highlight films, full-length wedding films, trailers, and social media reels.

- Transform raw wedding footage into beautifully crafted, emotionally engaging stories.

- Collaborate directly with the Creative Director to execute creative concepts and maintain a consistent editing style.

- Select meaningful moments, dialogue, music, and visuals to create compelling narratives.

- Perform professional color correction, cinematic color grading, sound design, and audio mixing.

- Seamlessly incorporate vows, speeches, ceremony footage, and other important wedding moments.

- Maintain organized editing timelines, project files, and media assets.

- Manage multiple wedding projects simultaneously while meeting production deadlines.

- Implement creative feedback and revisions efficiently.

- Maintain a high standard of quality, creativity, and attention to detail across all projects.



## Required Qualifications



**Applicants must meet the following requirements:**



- **Minimum 5 years of professional film or video editing experience.**

- Proven experience editing cinematic wedding films.

- Advanced proficiency in **Adobe Premiere Pro**.

- Experience with Adobe After Effects, Audition, and other Adobe Creative Cloud applications is highly preferred.

- Must have their own professional computer, licensed editing software, and access to all necessary editing tools.

- Must have a strong portfolio demonstrating professional wedding film editing skills.

- Excellent understanding of storytelling, cinematic composition, pacing, music selection, and emotional storytelling.

- Strong skills in color grading, sound design, audio mixing, and seamless transitions.

- Experience working with high-resolution footage, including 4K video.

- Ability to manage multiple projects and deliver high-quality work within established deadlines.

- Strong organizational skills, professionalism, and attention to detail.

- Excellent communication skills and ability to work directly with the Creative Director.

- Ability to receive constructive feedback and implement revisions.

- Reliable internet connection for transferring large video files and collaborating remotely.



## Who We're Looking For



**We are not looking for someone who simply knows how to edit videos. We are looking for a true visual storyteller.**



Our ideal editor understands the emotions, beauty, and storytelling that make wedding films memorable.



You should have a natural eye for cinematic visuals, a strong sense of musicality, and the ability to recognize meaningful moments that bring a couple's story to life.



We value creativity, consistency, reliability, and a genuine passion for filmmaking.



The right candidate should be confident working independently while following creative direction and maintaining the signature style and quality of My Wedding Media.



## Projects You Will Work On



- Cinematic wedding highlight films

- Full-length wedding documentary films

- Wedding trailers and teasers

- Social media wedding reels

- Ceremony and reception edits

- Additional creative filmmaking projects



You must be comfortable managing **multiple projects simultaneously** without compromising quality or deadlines.



## Interview & Paid Editing Project



Selected applicants will be invited to participate in our interview and evaluation process.



**Shortlisted candidates will be assigned a paid editing project** to demonstrate their technical abilities, creative storytelling, editing style, and ability to follow direction.



We will evaluate:



- Cinematic storytelling and creative vision

- Editing quality and attention to detail

- Music selection and emotional pacing

- Color grading and sound design

- Ability to follow creative direction

- Communication and project turnaround time



Candidates selected to complete the editing project will be compensated for their work.



## Compensation & Opportunity



Compensation will be based on experience, portfolio quality, project complexity, and editing capabilities.



We are looking for a dependable editor interested in building a **long-term professional relationship** with My Wedding Media as our company continues to grow.



## HOW TO APPLY



Please send your application directly to:







*
 Subject: Wedding Film Editor Application – [Your Name]**



Your
 must include:



1. **Introduction:** A brief introduction about yourself and your professional editing background.

2. **Portfolio:** A link to your professional portfolio showcasing your wedding film editing skills.

3. **Recent Work:** At least three examples of recent wedding films you personally edited.

4. **Adobe Experience:** A brief description of your experience with Adobe Premiere Pro and other editing tools.

We are excited to connect with talented editors who share our passion for cinematic filmmaking, meaningful storytelling, and exceptional creative work.



**My Wedding Media**  

*Capturing Love. Creating Timeless Films.*

title: Vehicle Research Assistant
description:
Job Title: Vehicle Acquisition Research Assistant (Automotive / Car Auctions)



Location: Remote

Job Type / Type of Employment: Part-Time 

Hours: ~24 hours/week

Pay: $4/hour





About the Position

We are a growing U.S.-based vehicle rental company looking for a reliable, detail-oriented, and resourceful Vehicle Acquisition Research Virtual Assistant to help us find potential vehicles to purchase and add to our fleet.



We regularly purchase vehicles through dealer-only auto auctions and other sources, including
 Marketplace.

Your primary responsibility will be to research upcoming auctions, identify promising vehicles, evaluate listings against our purchasing criteria, and organize your findings into clear, actionable reports.



We aren't looking for someone who simply copies and pastes car listings. We're looking for someone who can develop an understanding of what makes a vehicle a good investment for our business and help us consistently identify worthwhile purchasing opportunities.



You don't need to be a professional mechanic or car expert. We're willing to train the right person. However, strong research skills, attention to detail, organization, and independent thinking are essential.





Key Responsibilities

 • Research vehicles across auction platforms such as Manheim, ADESA, CarMax Auctions, and others.

 • Monitor upcoming auctions and newly added vehicle listings.

 • Create and update vehicle watchlists ahead of auction and preview deadlines.

 • Evaluate listings based on mileage, condition, title status, pricing, and our purchasing criteria.

 • Identify potential red flags and promising deals.

 • Research vehicles on
 Marketplace and other approved platforms.

 • Prepare clear daily reports with vehicle details, links, findings, and recommendations.

 • Track potential purchases, inspection results, and auction deadlines.

 • Eventually assist with coordinating vehicle inspections, communicating with mechanics, and contacting sellers.



Qualifications

Required:

 • Strong online research and analytical skills.

 • Excellent attention to detail and organization.

 • Comfortable working with spreadsheets, Google Sheets, and online platforms.

 • Ability to compare information and identify potential issues or inconsistencies.

 • Strong written English communication skills.

 • Ability to follow instructions while also thinking independently.

 • Reliable internet connection and computer.

 • Ability to meet deadlines and work consistently.

 • Willingness to learn about vehicles, automotive auctions, and our acquisition criteria.



Preferred but Not Required:

 • Experience researching used vehicles or automotive listings.

 • Familiarity with Manheim, ADESA, CarMax Auctions, or other vehicle auction platforms.

 • Knowledge of vehicle makes, models, reliability, and common mechanical issues.

 • Experience researching
 Marketplace listings.

 • Experience with vehicle history reports, VIN research, or automotive pricing.

 • Previous experience in automotive sales, dealerships, fleet management, or vehicle acquisition.



Automotive experience is a plus, but we're more interested in finding someone who is thorough, dependable, resourceful, and willing to learn.



Because auctions and vehicle preview opportunities occur throughout the week, some tasks will be time-sensitive.

We value efficiency and results. While accurate time reporting is expected, we don't believe in unnecessary micromanagement. We're looking for someone who can manage their responsibilities independently, meet deadlines, and consistently deliver quality work.



What We Offer

 • Long-term opportunity with a growing U.S.-based company.

 • Remote work with a flexible part-time schedule.

 • Training on our vehicle acquisition criteria and processes.

 • Opportunity to develop specialized automotive research and acquisition skills.

 • Increasing responsibility and independence as you demonstrate your capabilities.

 • Potential for additional hours and professional growth as our business expands.

 • Supportive, organized work environment that values initiative and problem-solving.



Who Would Be a Great Fit?

This position may be a great fit if you:

 • Enjoy researching and finding good deals.

 • Like comparing options and figuring out which ones are worth pursuing.

 • Are naturally curious and pay attention to details others might overlook.

 • Can work independently without needing constant supervision.

 • Take ownership of your responsibilities.

 • Enjoy learning new industries and developing specialized skills.

 • Prefer a position where your research and recommendations contribute directly to real business decisions.

We want someone who will eventually be able to look at a list of vehicles and confidently explain which ones deserve our attention, which ones should be avoided, and why.





How to Apply



Please submit:

 1. Your resume 

 2. A unique 1–2 minute video created specifically for this role 

In your video:

 • Introduce yourself 

 • Explain your relevant experience 

 • Tell us why you’d be a good fit for this position 

You may record your video using:

 • Loom 

 • Your phone 

 • Your laptop 

Upload the video to:

 • Loom 

 • Google Drive 

 • Dropbox 

Then send:

 • Your resume link 

 • Your video link 

through your OnlineJobs.ph application message.

Applications missing either link may not be considered. Please ensure all links are publicly viewable.

We are specifically looking for someone who has previously managed supply chains for **6–8 figure e-commerce brands**, ideally in the supplements and subscription-based business space.



This is a long-term opportunity with significant growth potential. **As our company scales, you will have the opportunity to step into a senior leadership position, build your own supply chain team, and manage its daily operations.**



### Your Responsibilities



- **Inventory Management & Forecasting:** Monitor stock levels, forecast inventory requirements, and prevent stockouts, especially for recurring subscription orders.

- **Supplier Communication & Negotiation:** Communicate directly with suppliers and negotiate pricing, shipping costs, and fulfillment terms.

- **Shopify Operations:** Review Shopify orders, fulfillment dashboards, and inventory data to identify discrepancies and ensure accurate supplier billing.

- **Subscription Stock Planning:** Forecast inventory based on recurring subscriptions, customer demand, and business growth.

- **Data Management:** Maintain organized Google Sheets for stock forecasts, supplier costs, inventory tracking, and operational reporting.

- **Cost Optimization:** Identify opportunities to reduce supply chain and fulfillment costs through supplier negotiations.

- **Future Team Leadership:** As we scale, help hire, train, and manage your own supply chain team.



### Requirements — MUST HAVE



- Proven experience managing supply chains for **6–8 figure e-commerce brands**.

- Previous experience with **supplement brands and subscription-based businesses**.

- Strong understanding of inventory forecasting for recurring subscription orders.

- Hands-on Shopify experience, particularly order management and fulfillment dashboards.

- Experience negotiating directly with suppliers and fulfillment partners.

- Strong Google Sheets and data management skills.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

- Ability to work independently, take ownership, and proactively solve problems.

- **Leadership mindset and ambition to eventually manage your own team.**



You must be able to demonstrate your previous supply chain experience with specific examples and results.



### Compensation & Working Hours



- **First 30 Days (Trial):** $1.50–$2.00 USD/hour

- **After Trial:** $2.00–$3.00 USD/hour

- **Starting Workload:** Approximately 1–2 hours per day

- **Schedule:** Flexible, fully remote

title: GoHighLevel Expert Needed to Build Snapshot, Funnels & Lead Automations
description:
GoHighLevel Expert Needed to Build Snapshot, Funnels & Lead Automations

Location: Remote

Project type: Initial setup project 20 to 30 hrs, with potential for ongoing work

Experience level: Experienced

Compensation: Please provide your proposed project rate or hourly rate

About the Project.







I’m looking for an experienced GoHighLevel specialist to help set up a lead generation and follow-up system for company, a local marketing business.



Our Business Helps local businesses, especially showrooms and home improvement companies, get found by more potential customers through Google Maps and local search.



The goal is to create a system that captures leads, follows up with them, and helps turn them into booked appointments. I’m also looking for a reusable GoHighLevel snapshot that can be updated and used as the business grows.





What You’ll Help Set Up

1. Lead Generation Funnels

Build or improve funnels that encourage prospects to request a free local visibility report or book a call.



This may include:

- Landing pages for lead capture and appointment booking.

- Forms and surveys to collect prospect information.

- Calendar integration and booking confirmations.

- Thank-you pages with clear next steps.

- Mobile-friendly layouts.

- Basic tracking for form submissions and booked appointments.





I can provide information about the offer, target audience, branding, and any existing pages. I’d like your recommendations on what can be reused and what should be built or improved.



2. Lead Follow-Up Automations

Create practical workflows that help us respond to and follow up with leads, including:

- Follow-up when someone submits a form or requests a report.

-
 and SMS follow-up, where appropriate.

- Appointment confirmations and reminders.

- Follow-up for missed appointments and cancellations.

- Follow-up for leads who have not booked a call.

- Notifications and tasks for our team.

- Tags and pipeline updates based on lead activity.

- Stopping or adjusting follow-up when someone books, replies, or asks not to be contacted.

I’d like someone who can recommend the right workflow and messaging based on our sales process, not just build a large number of automations.





3. CRM and Sales Pipeline

Organize GoHighLevel so we can easily track leads from the first interaction through the sales process.



This may include:

- Setting up or improving the sales pipeline and opportunity stages.

- Creating custom fields, tags, and lead sources.

- Organizing leads from forms, calls, and other outreach.

- Creating tasks and notifications for follow-up.

- Providing a clear way to see where each prospect stands.



4. Reusable GoHighLevel Snapshot





Create a snapshot containing the agreed-upon components, such as workflows, funnels, forms, pipeline stages, and custom fields.



Please identify anything that must be configured separately when the snapshot is installed in another account, such as integrations, connected calendars, phone numbers, or sending settings. I’d also like you to test the snapshot in a separate account or test environment, if available.

What I’m Looking For

- Proven experience building GoHighLevel funnels, workflows, and snapshots.

- Experience setting up lead generation and appointment-booking systems.

- Ability to organize a CRM and sales pipeline.

- Experience with
 and SMS follow-up workflows.

- Good understanding of forms, calendars, tags, custom fields, and triggers.

- Ability to explain your recommendations clearly.

- Strong attention to detail and willingness to test your work.

- Clear communication and reliable delivery.





Experience working with marketing agencies, local businesses, Google Business Profile services, or local SEO is a plus.

Deliverables

At the end of the project, I’d like:

- The agreed-upon funnels, pipeline, and automations built and tested.

- A reusable snapshot with the agreed components.

- A list of what is included and what requires separate setup.

- A short walkthrough video or live walkthrough explaining how everything works.

- Basic documentation so my team can manage and update the system.

How to Apply

Please keep your application focused and answer the following:

1. Experience: How long have you worked with GoHighLevel, and what types of systems have you built?

2. Examples: Share one or two examples of funnels, automations, or snapshots you’ve created. Please explain what you personally built.

3. Approach: How would you set up follow-up for someone who requests a free visibility report but does not book a call?

4. Snapshot: What are some things that may need to be configured separately after installing a snapshot?

5. Availability: When can you start, and how many hours per week are you available?

6. Pricing: What is your hourly rate? If you prefer project-based pricing, explain what information you need to provide a quote.

Please begin your application with “GHL Lead System” so I know you’ve read the description.



Selected applicants may be invited to a short video call to discuss the project and their experience.



Thank you,

Hank

title: Technical Support Specialist
description:
• Pay: USD 950 a month base, plus performance incentives. Our top performers take home about USD 1,100 to 1,200 a month.

• Shift: Monday to Friday, US Eastern daytime in staggered shifts between 8 AM and 8 PM, with some weekend shifts and on-call turns (a night shift in Manila)

• Benefits: HMO from your third month, flexible paid time off

• Where: fully remote



THE JOB

Our patients are mostly older adults at home in the US with heart failure or COPD. They see their care team by video on a tablet we send them, and their pulse oximeter and blood pressure monitor send readings to us. When something stops working, you are the person who fixes it, often by walking a patient who is not comfortable with technology through it one step at a time.



You take about 50 calls a day from patients and clinicians: a tablet that will not join a visit, a device that stopped sending readings, a clinician who needs help in Athenahealth. You own each problem until it is solved, and you write clear reports for our engineers when something needs a fix on their side.



WHAT YOU NEED



• 2 or more years in technical or customer support where you solved technology problems for customers

• Tech savviness: you pick up new devices and tools quickly (Android tablets, Zoom, Google Workspace)

• A friendly, patient way of helping older adults in the US, in clear English

• Reliable high-speed internet and availability for this shift for the long term

Experience with Samsung Knox or another device-management tool, remote monitoring devices, Athenahealth, or an issue tracker such as GitLab is a plus.



HOW TO APPLY (ABOUT 15 MINUTES)



1. Apply only at https://www.ansiblehealth.com/careers/jobs/telehealth-technical-support-357d36ee/apply?ref=kvmg4yxd . Applications sent any other way are not reviewed.

2. Answer a few quick questions, including one troubleshooting scenario. When the form asks for the word from this posting, type TABLET.

3. Record your voice on the form: read three lines from a real support call, then talk a patient through joining his visit (about five minutes).

4. Give your earliest start date and the notice you owe your current employer.

If you are shortlisted, we email you a link to book a 15-minute call with our recruiter.

title: Instagram Reels Editor & Creative Strategist
description:
About the Role:



•⁠  ⁠We’re looking for a creative video editor to help edit short travel content 
 so they perform as effectively as possible on social media.



•⁠  ⁠The page focuses on short cinematic travel, bucket-list destinations, adventure, and real moments with Alfonso exploring the world. We don't require heavy special effects, complex software, or fancy motion graphics. CapCut or any tool you prefer is more than enough for the style of content we create. 



What Matters Most



•⁠  ⁠As seen 
 IG, the editing is not technically complex. The focus is on choosing the strongest clips, placing them in the most effective order, using text where needed to support the story and retention, and creating a cinematic flow that keeps people watching.



What You'll Be Doing



•⁠  ⁠Editing & Pacing: Turning raw travel footage into viral high-retention Reels (around 6 to 25 seconds long).

•⁠  ⁠Finding the Hook: Figuring out the best way to open each video so people stop scrolling.

•⁠  ⁠Working Together: Teaming up with us on feedback, alternative versions, and tweaking things based on what performs well.



Pay Structure



•⁠  ⁠$100/month Base Retainer: This guarantees a steady base to cover trial experimentation, testing hooks, exploring ideas, revisions, and creative back-and-forth communication.

•⁠  ⁠Trial vs. Main Posts: During experimentation, you will test and pitch trial edits. When a trial is polished and approved to go live as a main post 
 it turns into a payable item!

•⁠  ⁠+$20 per Reel published on the main page (we usually expect 1 to 3 posted per week).

•⁠  ⁠+$20 bonus for any single Reel that hits 1,000+ new followers within 90 days. (Bonuses apply while we're actively working together).

•⁠  ⁠Everything is tallied up and paid out monthly.



Volume & Expectations



•⁠  ⁠Minimum: 1 published Reel per week

•⁠  ⁠Normal range: 1–3 published Reels per week

•⁠  ⁠More can be published when strong ideas are working

•⁠  ⁠Output may be lower at the beginning while we learn what works best together



What We Look For



•⁠  ⁠A good eye for cinematic flow, beautiful travel shots, and visual storytelling.

•⁠  ⁠Solid grasp of short-form social media (knowing how to pace a video so it doesn't get boring).

•⁠  ⁠Someone who actually watches social media trends and understands why certain videos grab attention.

•⁠  ⁠A willingness to test ideas and learn as we go.



How to Apply



To make sure you're a great fit for this role, please include the following in your application:

•⁠  ⁠Link to your portfolio with your best travel, lifestyle, or cinematic Reels (experience with travel and cinematic editing is preferred).

•⁠  ⁠Briefly walk us through your process once you receive raw content, how do you usually organize, tackle a project, and collaborate on feedback?

•⁠  ⁠Pick one 
 existing Instagram Reels, and in 3-4 sentences, pitch an alternative hook and a quick concept breakdown for how you would have edited it differently to capture attention faster.

title: Lead Researcher / List Builder – Amazon Seller Leads (Verified Emails, No Duplicates)
description:
We are a Dubai-based e-commerce consultancy working with Amazon brands and sellers in Germany, the UK and the US. We need someone who builds clean, verified lead lists of Amazon sellers for our outbound campaigns.



This is detail work. We do not need volume. We need lists we can load into our sending tool without cleaning them first.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Research Amazon third-party sellers and brands and deliver them in a Google Sheet with these exact columns:



First Name

Last Name

Job Title


LinkedIn URL

Company Name

Amazon Seller Page (storefront or brand page URL)

Company Country

Seller Type (Private Label / Brand Owner / Reseller / Aggregator / Agency)

Company Website

Employees

Company LinkedIn URL

Monthly Revenue (estimate)

Review Rating



QUALITY RULES (this is what the job is really about)



1. Right person, not just any person. We need the decision maker: Founder, Owner, CEO, Managing Director, Head of E-Commerce, Amazon Manager, Marketplace Manager. Not interns, not warehouse staff, not accountants. If a company has no reachable decision maker, skip it.



2. Verified emails only. Every personal email must be run through a verification tool (NeverBounce, MillionVerifier, ZeroBounce or similar) and marked as valid. "Accept-all" or "risky" results are not acceptable and must be excluded, not included with a note. Our bounce rate must stay under 2 percent.



3. Zero duplicates. No duplicate emails, no duplicate companies, no duplicate domains across the whole list AND against the master list we give you. You dedupe before you deliver, not us.



4. Amazon Seller Page is mandatory. If you cannot find the actual Amazon storefront or brand page of the company, the lead does not go on the list. This is our most important filter. A company that "probably sells on Amazon" is not a lead.



5. Revenue estimate must come from a source. Use Helium 10, Jungle Scout, SellerAmp, Keepa, Similarweb or public company data. Write the source in a notes column. Never guess.



6. Data must be clean. Correct spelling and capitalisation of first names (we use them in email personalisation, so "MARIA" or "maria" or "M. Schmidt" is a fail), no trailing spaces, consistent country names, working URLs.



TOOLS

You should be comfortable with at least some of: 
, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, 
, 
, Clay, Helium 10 / Jungle Scout / Keepa, Google Sheets. Tell us which ones you have access to and which ones we would need to provide.



WHO THIS IS FOR

You are a good fit if you are patient, precise, and you would rather deliver 100 perfect leads than 500 messy ones. You check your own work before you send it. You ask questions when a rule is unclear instead of guessing.



You are not a good fit if you plan to scrape a database, export it and send it over unverified. We check every list we receive.



HOURS AND START

Start part time, around 20 hours per week, with a fixed weekly delivery target we agree together. If the quality is right, this becomes a long-term full-time role with a raise. We pay on time, every time.



HOW TO APPLY

Please do not send a generic application. Answer these in your message:



1. Put the word AMAZON-LIST in the first line of your application, so we know you read this.

2. Which tools do you currently have paid access to?

3. How do you verify an email before putting it on a list? Name the tool and the exact steps.

4. How would you find the Amazon storefront of a brand when the brand does not link to it from their website?

5. Send one sample: 5 real Amazon seller leads with all columns above filled in. Use any niche you like. This tells us more than your CV.



Applications without the sample will not be reviewed.
