title: Senior Operations VA for Short Term Rental
description:
Overview

We operate a 30+ unit Airbnb/STR portfolio across multiple US markets. Our AI messaging system already handles routine guest messages. We are NOT hiring someone to answer messages. We are hiring someone to solve the problems the AI can't — the locked-out guest at 9PM, the cleaner who didn't show, the vendor who quoted double, the damage claim that needs evidence assembled.

This role comes with real decision-making authority. You will have written authority limits (e.g, approve vendor spend up to a set amount, guest issues) and you are expected to USE them without asking permission. In this company, you will never be penalized for making a reasonable decision within your authority. You WILL be coached if you escalate things you had the authority to d
 yourself.

Top performers are compensated above market and given increasing ownership as we scale — our next team lead will be promoted from this role, not hired externally.

Must-Haves (do not apply without these)

* You already live a night-shift lifestyle. Shifts are 9 hours within 7AM–8PM PST (roughly 10PM–11AM Philippine time). Do not apply if you plan to "adjust" — we only hire people who have ALREADY worked graveyard/US hours for 6+ months and can tell us how they sustain it. This is a hard filter; our last several departures were all sleep-schedule failures.

* 1+ year hands-on STR/Airbnb operations experience (guest issues, cleaner coordination, OTA platforms). PMS/channel manager familiarity.

* Airbnb claims/AirCover experience strongly preferred.

* Strong spoken English — this role makes multiple phone calls daily to US-based guests, cleaners, and vendors. You must be comfortable picking up the phone without being told to.

* Comfortable being the most senior person online during your shift. There is no manager to hand problems off to.

Key Responsibilities

* Own all guest issues the AI escalates: access problems, WiFi, appliances, complaints, special requests — resolve end-to-end

* Coordinate cleaners: scheduling, confirmations, photo QC, same-day turnover problems

* Manage vendors and maintenance: source quotes, schedule, follow up, verify completion

* Handle Airbnb claims and damage documentation

* Maintain calendar accuracy across Airbnb, VRBO, 
, and direct bookings

* Convert every escalation into a documented rule/SOP so the same problem never needs an owner decision twice

* Weekend coverage required (especially Sunday/Monday mornings PST)

Work Setup

Remote, full-time, 2 days off per week. 9-hour shift within the 7AM–8PM PST window (exact shift set at hiring). [
a month paid bi-weekly depending on experience], performance raises reviewed at 90 days.

HOW TO APPLY — read carefully, incomplete applications are auto-rejected

Start your application with the word LIGHTHOUSE so we know you read this posting.

Our hiring process has three stages: this written application, an unscheduled live video call where we work through operational scenarios together in real time, and a paid trial shift. Your written answers will be verified in detail on the live call — only apply with real experience, because invented details do not survive stage two. We screen for AI-generated responses and disqualify them.

1. Your actual experience — state facts, we will verify them

* Maximum number of units you handled AT THE SAME TIME (not cumulative), and for how long

* Which markets/states, and which PMS/channel manager you used daily

* How many cleaners and vendors you personally coordinated

* On a typical day, how many guest escalations did you handle, and what were the two most common types?

2. Night-shift proof: How long have you worked PH graveyard hours continuously, for which employer, and what is your actual daily sleep routine?

3. Judgment scenario: A guest at check-in messages that the smart lock is dead. The cleaner isn't answering. It's 9PM local time and the owner is unreachable for the next 3 hours. Walk us through everything you do, in exact order, including what you d
 WITHOUT permission and what your fallback is if your first fix fails. (Finalists will solve a live variation of this on camera.)

4. Systems example: Describe, in this numbered format:

1. A specific operational problem you personally faced

2. The exact system or process you built to prevent it recurring

3. The measurable result — include real numbers

Applications that skip the keyword, answer the scenario with "I would contact the owner," or give generic answers with no specific details will not receive a response.

title: CEO
description:
About the Role



This is not a virtual assistant position. You will run our online channels the way a general manager runs a business. You will report directly to our CEO, lead a small team of platform specialists, and be responsible for one clear goal: building our online business to USD 3 million in annual sales within 18 months. If you have ever wanted to be treated as the owner of a business instead of a task worker, and you have the experience to hit a target like this, this role is built for you.



Our 18 Month Goal



- Month 6: online sales of USD 100,000 per month

- Month 12: online sales of USD 175,000 per month

- Month 18: online sales of USD 250,000 per month, a USD 3 million annual run rate

- All growth must be profitable, with advertising spend kept within agreed limits



Compensation



- Base salary of PHP 120,000 to 130,000 per month, based on experience

- Quarterly performance bonus based on growth in online gross profit

- Milestone bonuses paid when each of the month 6, 12, and 18 targets is reached

- Eligibility for a long term profit sharing arrangement after 12 months for the right person

- Paid time off and holidays

- A direct relationship with the CEO and real authority to make decisions



We currently sell one brand online and are preparing to launch our second brand along with several new products. Your mission is to lead that expansion and build our online business into a major sales channel for the company. Within your first six months, we expect our second brand and new products to be live across our online channels. By month 12, we are targeting online sales of USD 70,000 to 110,000 per month. By month 18, our committed goal is USD 125,000 per month, with a stretch goal of USD 250,000 per month, which represents a USD 3 million annual run rate. All growth must be profitable, with advertising spend kept within agreed limits, and bonuses are significantly larger for reaching the stretch goal.



Your base salary will be PHP 120,000 to 130,000 per month, based on experience, plus a 13th month payment each December. When our second brand and new products are successfully launched within your first six months, you will receive a USD 1,500 launch bonus. Starting in month 7, you will earn a quarterly bonus equal to 5 percent of the growth in our online contribution profit, which is net sales after product costs, platform fees, fulfillment, advertising, and returns. You will also earn milestone bonuses of USD 2,000 for reaching the month 12 committed goal or USD 4,000 for reaching the stretch goal, and USD 4,000 for reaching the month 18 committed goal or USD 10,000 for reaching the stretch goal. After 12 months, the right person will also become eligible for a long term profit sharing arrangement in the online business. If we reach USD 3 million together, your total earnings will place you among the best compensated ecommerce leaders in the Philippines.

How to Apply



Please send:

- Your resume

- A short summary of 2 to 3 online stores or brands you managed, including what you grew sales from and to

- A 2 to 3 minute video introducing yourself and explaining how you would approach growing a food and beverage brand to USD 3 million in online sales in 18 months

title: Remote Appointment Setter / Virtual Assistant
description:

Schedule: Part-time to start, with availability during USA business hours

Time:    Mostly  2am to 9am  Phillipines Time zone or PDT Time

Compensation: Please include your expected hourly rate. Performance bonuses may be discussed.

No experience Neccessary.  If you are a confident Speaker we can train you.  

Beginner Pay Rate:   $3

Immediate Rate:    $4

Expert Rate:   $5



We’re looking for a friendly, confident appointment setter to call local businesses in the United States and schedule short introductory calls with our marketing specialist.



You’ll work from a provided list of businesses and use a calling script to guide the conversation. Your main goal is to connect with the owner, manager, or person responsible for attracting customers and either:

1. Schedule a 15-minute introductory call, or

2. Collect their
 address if they would like more information.







You will not be responsible for closing sales. Our marketing specialist handles the sales conversation.

Responsibilities

- Call local businesses from a provided lead list.

- Ask to speak with the owner, manager, or person responsible for attracting new customers.

- Briefly explain the purpose of the call using a provided script.

- Schedule interested prospects for a 15-minute call.

- Collect and confirm
 addresses from prospects who want more information.

- Record call outcomes and notes in our CRM or tracking system.

- Follow up with interested prospects when appropriate.

- Share common questions and objections to help improve the calling process.





Requirements

- Clear spoken English and strong listening skills.

- Experience with cold calling, appointment setting, telemarketing, or lead generation.

- A friendly, professional approach and confidence speaking with business owners.

- Ability to follow a script while having a natural conversation.

- Reliable internet, a computer, a headset, and a quiet place to work.

- Availability during US business hours.

- Ability to maintain accurate records and follow up consistently.

Experience calling local businesses or using GoHighLevel is a plus. Training and a calling script will be provided.





How to Apply

Please send the following:

1. Your experience: Briefly describe your cold-calling or appointment-setting experience. What types of businesses have you called?

2. Your availability: Include your location, time zone, and the hours you can work during US business hours.

3. Your rate: Share your expected hourly rate.

4. Your approach: In two or three sentences, explain what you would say if a prospect told you, “Just send me an
.”

5. Voice recording: Record yourself saying the following, then continue naturally as if the person confirmed the business name:

Record your self free here.  

   “Hi, is this ABC Plumbing?”  [Continue to say Something]

   

   In the rest of the recording, ask to speak with the person responsible for bringing new customers into the business. Keep the recording 30 to no more than one minute.





6. Attention to detail: Begin your application with the words “Ready to call.”





Selected applicants will be invited to a short interview and may be offered a paid calling trial.



Best if you have these traits:  



Primary Trait: Influencer (I)

The Influencer trait is characterized by confidence, friendliness, and excellent interpersonal skills. Appointment setters need to engage business owners, create rapport, and encourage them to schedule calls with a marketing specialist. A high I trait helps in establishing a connection, making conversations feel natural, and using a scripted approach while remaining personable.



Secondary Trait: Steadiness (S)

The Steadiness personality trait complements the Influencer trait by bringing patience and a supportive nature. This role involves persistence in follow-ups and the ability to listen to prospects, which aligns well with the S trait. A person with high steadiness can provide reassurance and maintain a calm demeanor, which can be crucial when handling objections or trying to engage hesitant prospects.

title: digital marketing and lead generation specialist
description:
# Performance Marketing & Content Specialist



**Full-Time | Remote | UK Service Business**



We are an established and growing UK window cleaning and exterior cleaning business looking for a talented **Performance Marketing & Content Specialist** to take ownership of our digital marketing.



We already have established websites, social media pages and a large existing customer base. We are now looking for someone who can help us significantly grow our online customer acquisition as we expand into new areas.



This is a hands-on position combining **Google Ads, Meta Ads, lead generation, landing pages, social media, content creation and local community marketing.**



Our main goal is simple:



**Generate more high-quality customers at a profitable cost while continuing to build our brands online.**



## Google Ads – Core Responsibility



Google Ads will be one of the most important parts of your role.



You will be responsible for:



* Creating, managing and optimising Google Search campaigns

* Keyword and competitor research

* Geographic targeting across different UK towns and areas

* Keyword, match-type and negative keyword management

* Search-term analysis

* Writing and testing ad copy

* Managing bidding strategies and budgets

* Setting up and maintaining conversion tracking

* Monitoring cost per lead and cost per acquired customer

* Identifying opportunities to increase lead volume

* Continually testing and improving campaign performance



You should be confident taking ownership of Google Ads campaigns and making decisions based on data.



## Meta Ads – Core Responsibility



**Meta Ads is equally important to Google Ads in this position.**



You will manage advertising across
 and Instagram using **Meta Ads Manager**.



Responsibilities include:



* Creating and managing lead-generation campaigns

* Audience research and targeting

* Geographic targeting

* Creating and testing different offers

* Developing advertising copy and creatives

* Creating video advertisements

* Retargeting campaigns

* A/B testing

* Monitoring cost per lead

* Monitoring lead quality

* Tracking customer acquisition

* Scaling successful campaigns

* Identifying and stopping underperforming campaigns



We want someone who understands the difference between generating **cheap leads** and generating **quality leads that become paying customers**.



## Content Creation



Content creation is an important part of this position.



Our UK team will provide photographs and raw video footage from jobs. Your responsibility will be to turn this material into professional, engaging content.



You should be confident using:



* **CapCut**

* **Canva**

* Other video and graphic editing software

* AI editing and content tools where appropriate



You will create:



* Instagram Reels

* TikTok videos

*
 videos

* Before-and-after content

* Short-form advertising creatives

* Customer testimonials

* Educational content

* Promotional content

* Local/community content

* Graphics and social media posts



You should understand hooks, pacing, subtitles, captions, calls to action and how to turn simple raw footage into content people actually want to watch.



##
, Instagram & TikTok



You will help manage and grow our organic presence across:



*
 | Instagram | TikTok**



Responsibilities include:



* Planning and scheduling content

* Creating and editing posts

* Creating Reels and TikToks

* Repurposing successful content across platforms

* Researching relevant trends and content ideas

* Testing different styles of content

* Building brand awareness within the geographical areas we operate

* Helping develop our overall social media strategy



Experience with TikTok Ads is beneficial but not essential.



## Local
 Group & Community Marketing



An important part of this role will be actively finding potential customers through **local
 groups and community pages**.



We operate across multiple towns and continue to expand into new areas, so we want someone who is proactive in finding local online communities where potential customers are already looking for our services.



You will be expected to:



* Find and join relevant local
 groups and community pages

* Participate through an appropriate individual profile where permitted by the group's rules

* Regularly monitor local groups for people asking for **window cleaner recommendations**

* Look for posts requesting window cleaning, gutter cleaning and other relevant exterior cleaning services

* Respond quickly and professionally to relevant posts

* Introduce and recommend our services where appropriate

* Create promotional posts in groups that allow advertising

* Engage naturally with local communities rather than simply posting repetitive advertisements

* Find new groups within areas we currently cover

* Research groups within new locations before we expand into them

* Keep track of group rules and which groups allow promotional posts

* Direct interested customers to our website, quotation form or appropriate contact channel

* Track enquiries and customers generated through
 groups



We are **not looking for someone to spam groups or create fake customer recommendations**.



We want someone who can genuinely participate in local communities, spot opportunities and professionally introduce our business when someone is looking for the services we provide.



## Landing Pages & Conversion



You should be capable of creating and improving landing pages to support our Google and Meta advertising campaigns.



This includes:



* Creating campaign-specific landing pages

* Creating pages targeting different services and locations

* Building enquiry forms

* Writing effective headlines and calls to action

* Ensuring pages are mobile-friendly

* Improving conversion rates

* A/B testing pages and offers

* Connecting forms to our lead-management systems

* Meta Pixel setup

* Google Ads conversion tracking

* Google Analytics and Tag Manager where required



You do not need to be an advanced web developer, but you should be comfortable using modern landing-page builders and making changes yourself.



## Performance & Reporting



We are a **results-driven business**.



Followers, likes and views have value, but our primary objective is **generating paying customers**.



You will be expected to monitor and understand:



* Advertising spend

* Leads generated

* Cost per lead

* Cost per acquired customer

* Lead quality

* Conversion rates

* Google Ads performance

* Meta Ads performance

* Landing-page conversion rates

* Leads generated through local
 groups

* Best-performing advertisements and creatives

* Best-performing geographical areas

* Opportunities to scale



We want someone who can tell us:



**What worked? What didn't? Why? What should we test next?**



## What We're Looking For



You should have strong experience with:



* **Google Ads**

* **Meta Ads Manager**

*
 & Instagram advertising

* Lead-generation campaigns

* Google Search campaigns

* Conversion tracking

* Landing pages

* **CapCut**

* **Canva**

* Short-form video editing

* Instagram Reels

* TikTok

*
 groups/community marketing

* Advertising creatives

* Copywriting

* Analytics and reporting



Previous experience generating leads for **local service businesses** would be a major advantage.



Experience marketing businesses in the **UK, USA, Canada or Australia** would also be beneficial.



## The Right Person



We're looking for someone who is:



* Proactive

* Creative

* Analytical

* Reliable

* Organised

* Comfortable working independently

* Excellent at written English

* Confident making decisions based on data

* Willing to experiment and test new ideas

* Comfortable engaging with people online

* Interested in learning new tools

* Focused on measurable business results



We don't want someone who waits to be told exactly what advert, video or post to create next.



We want someone who can understand our goals, analyse the results and proactively say:



**“Here's what I think we should try next.”**



## Working With Us



We already employ a **long-term team member based in the Philippines** who works closely with our UK team, so we have experience employing and supporting remote Filipino staff.



For shortlisted candidates, we're happy to arrange an opportunity to speak privately with our existing Philippines-based team member, **Mikaella**.



You can ask her directly about her experience working with us, our management style, reliability of pay, working environment and what it's genuinely like being part of our team.



We believe recruitment works both ways. We want to make sure you're right for us, but we also want you to be comfortable that **we're the right employer for you**.



We're looking for someone who wants to build a **long-term career with us as the company continues to grow.**



## Salary



**?45,000–?65,000 PHP per month, depending on experience and ability.**



This is a **full-time, long-term position**.



## How to Apply



Please provide:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Details of your experience with **Google Ads**.

3. Details of your experience with **Meta Ads**.

4. Screenshots or evidence of previous advertising results.

5. Examples of advertising budgets you have managed.

, Instagram or TikTok content you have created.

10. Details of any experience using **local
 groups to generate leads or customers**.

11. Your expected monthly salary.

12. A link to your portfolio, if available.



Please start your application with the words **“LOCAL LEADS”** so we know you have read the entire job description.



Applications that don't provide examples of previous work or results may not be considered.

title: Operations Manager
description:
The Operations Manager runs the operational backbone of the business and acts as the Management Representative for our Integrated Management System. You will keep day-to-day operations running smoothly and compliantly — procurement, supplier, asset and access management, business continuity, document control and cross-department coordination across our UK and Philippines teams — while owning the QMS, ISMS and AIMS: maintaining them, keeping them audit-ready, running internal audits and management reviews, and driving continual improvement. You will also run the quarterly project cadence that keeps every department's projects on track. It is a hands-on governance and operations leadership role reporting directly to the Managing Director, with scope to build an Operations Assistant function and automate recurring work.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Integrated Management System & governance (Management Representative)

• Establish, maintain and continually improve the IMS across ISO 9001, ISO 27001 and ISO 42001, and report its performance to top management.

• Own the internal audit programme end-to-end — plan, schedule, conduct or coordinate audits, log findings and drive them to closure; act as primary liaison with BSI and external/certification auditors.

• Organise and facilitate management reviews; capture minutes, decisions and actions.

• Run document control: the controlled-document register, version control, scheduled reviews and approvals.

• Coordinate nonconformity and corrective/preventive action (NC/CAPA) across all three systems, tracking each to closure.

• Own the integrated risk & opportunity process: maintain the register, facilitate assessments,

drive treatments and recommend residual-risk acceptance to the Managing Director.

• Steward the scope, Statement of Applicability, policies and objectives, keeping them current.



Project & portfolio governance

• Run the quarterly project cadence across the business — review each department's projects to ensure they are running as planned, on scope and on schedule.

• Maintain the project tracker; surface slippage, risks, blockers and dependencies, and hold owners to their commitments.

• Report project status and portfolio health to the Managing Director, and keep BAU (run) work and project (change) work clearly separated.



Compliance, information security & risk

• Administer information-security operations: asset inventory, access identities and periodic user-access reviews, supplier/third-party security management, BYOD compliance, i
 logging and coordination, and change management.

• Maintain the legal, regulatory and contractual requirements register and coordinate operational compliance (UK GDPR/data protection, sector and AI-governance obligations).

• Own business-continuity and disaster-recovery readiness — plans, drills and tests.



Operations & resource management

• Run the procurement and purchasing process, including supplier onboarding and due diligence.

• Coordinate cross-department alignment – weekly scoreboards and accountability, townhall inputs and BAU governance.

• Manage company tooling and the asset lifecycle; support operational budgeting.



People & culture (in partnership with HR)

• Support HR on onboarding/offboarding, the recruitment pipeline, the training & competence framework, the PDP cycle and rota/payroll oversight (HR owns execution).

• Champion an accountability culture across the UK and Philippines teams, and maintain the competence & awareness (training) matrix.



Performance, reporting & continual improvement

• Own monitoring and measurement – KPIs, scoreboards and performance evaluation – and report to leadership.

• Drive continual improvement and manage organisational change.



Leadership, delegation & automation

• Line-manage the operations and people-support functions; delegate effectively, and build and develop an Operations Assistant role.

• Use work-management tooling (
) and AI-enabled automation to streamline recurring governance and BAU work.





QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE & TRACK RECORD

We are hiring for experience. What you have actually run matters far more to us than the certificates you hold — a strong operator who has genuinely owned a live management system will always beat a certificate on its own. You should be able to point to concrete examples for most of the below.

• 5+ years in operations, quality or business-management roles, including at least 2 years managing people or running a function.

• Hands-on experience owning or running a live, ISO-certified management system in day-to-day operation — ISO 9001 and/or ISO 27001 (ISO 42001 a plus). This means having actually maintained it — document control, internal audits, management reviews, corrective actions and risk — not simply holding a certificate.

• Direct experience of external certification audits — preparing for and being audited by a certification body (e.g. BSI or similar) and taking findings and nonconformities through to closure.

• Proven experience running internal audits (ISO 19011 principles) and managing NC/CAPA and a risk & opportunity register.

• Experience running a regular project review or cadence and keeping delivery on track across multiple teams or departments.

• Practical experience of information-security governance operations — access reviews, asset management, supplier/third-party risk, i
 handling and business continuity.

• Experience of document control / management-system administration.

• Experience coordinating distributed or offshore teams (e.g. UK and Philippines) and working across time zones.

• Hands-on with 
 or a comparable work-management platform, and comfortable using automation or AI to reduce manual work.

• Experience line-managing, delegating and building out a team or an assistant function.

• Sound data-protection / UK GDPR awareness and the discretion to handle confidential security, HR and commercial information.

• Excellent English communication and stakeholder management at all levels, including with senior leadership and external auditors.

• Highly organised and self-directed — able to manage many concurrent recurring obligations to deadline with minimal supervision.

We prioritise proven experience over formal qualifications. A relevant degree (business, operations, quality or information management) is welcome but not essential, and ISO / audit certifications are a nice-to-have rather than a prerequisite — we will happily consider candidates whose hands-on track record demonstrates the same capability.



DESIRABLE/NICE TO HAVE (not required)

None of the below is essential — they are advantages. Where a certification is listed, equivalent hands-on experience is valued just as highly.

• ISO 27001 and/or ISO 9001 Lead Auditor or Internal Auditor certification – a bonus, not a prerequisite.

• A project-management qualification or method (e.g. PRINCE2, Agile) or a comparable delivery track record.

• ISO 42001/AI-governance exposure.

• Cyber Essentials familiarity; a data-protection qualification (e.g. GDPR Practitioner, CIPP/E).

• Procurement/vendor-management experience.

• Continual-improvement methods (Lean, Six Sigma) or change-management exposure.

• Experience in a SaaS or technology business.

title: Patient Onboarding Specialist

• Pay: USD 750 a month base, plus performance incentives with no cap. Our top performers take home USD 1,300 to 1,500 a month.

• Benefits: HMO from your third month, flexible paid time off

THE JOB

Health systems across the US refer older patients with heart failure or COPD to us, often after a hospital stay. You call them, explain in plain words how our doctors, nurses and respiratory therapists can care for them at home, and book their first video visit.

A healthcare degree, US healthcare accounts, sales or appointment-setting experience, or Spanish are a plus.



This is a phone job with daily targets, not back-office or

title: General Ledger Accountant
description:
Position Type: Part-Time (Potential for Full-Time Conversion)

Industry: Private Family Office / Wealth & Asset Management

Location: 100% Remote – Philippines

Compensation: $7.00 – $9.00 USD per Hour + Up to 10% Performance-Based Monthly Bonus



We are seeking a detail-oriented, organized, and dependable Part-Time General Ledger (GL) Accountant to support accounting and financial reporting activities for multiple private family offices serving high-net-worth (HNW) and ultra-high-net-worth (UHNW) individuals and families.



The GL Accountant will be responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, reconciling accounts, assisting with financial reporting, and supporting day-to-day accounting operations across multiple client entities.



This position offers the potential for full-time conversion based on individual performance, organizational needs, and position availability.



Primary Responsibilities:

• Maintain accurate and complete general ledger records for multiple clients, entities, and accounts, ensuring transactions are properly recorded and classified.

• Prepare, review, and post journal entries, including accruals, prepaid expenses, depreciation, amortization, reclassifications, and other adjusting entries.

• Perform monthly bank, credit card, investment account, and balance sheet reconciliations, identifying and resolving discrepancies in a timely manner.

• Prepare and maintain supporting schedules, account analyses, and financial reports, including balance sheets, income statements, and general ledger detail reports.

• Review and reconcile intercompany transactions, related-party balances, and transfers between multiple entities and accounts.

• Assist with accounts payable, accounts receivable, expense classifications, and other general accounting activities as needed.

• Review bank statements, investment statements, invoices, receipts, and other supporting documentation to ensure transactions are accurately recorded.

• Communicate professionally with clients and internal team members via
 and scheduled meetings to request supporting documentation, clarify transactions, and resolve outstanding accounting matters.

• Assist with special accounting projects, financial analyses, process improvements, and other assignments as needed.



Qualifications:



Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

• Minimum of 2 years of professional accounting experience, preferably involving general ledger accounting, journal entries, account reconciliations, and financial reporting.

• Solid understanding of basic accounting principles, double-entry bookkeeping, accrual accounting, and general ledger maintenance.

• Experience preparing journal entries, reconciling bank and balance sheet accounts, and assisting with month-end closing procedures.

• Ability to review financial transactions, identify discrepancies, investigate variances, and resolve accounting issues accurately and efficiently.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and account reconciliation worksheets.

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to professionally communicate with U.S.-based clients and internal team members.

• Excellent organizational skills, strong attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple client accounts, assignments, and deadlines.

• Ability to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining consistent communication, accountability, and timely completion of assigned responsibilities.

• High level of professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality when handling sensitive client financial information.



Preferred Qualifications:

• Three (3) or more years of general ledger accounting, financial reporting, or bookkeeping experience.

• Experience supporting U.S.-based clients, privately held businesses, family offices, or accounting firms.

• Familiarity with U.S. Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (U.S. GAAP) and accrual-based accounting.

• Experience preparing financial statement packages, supporting schedules, and month-end closing workpapers.



Work Arrangement & Full-Time Conversion Opportunity

This is a 100% remote, part-time position based in the Philippines. Candidates must be available for scheduled meetings and client communications during designated U.S. business hours. Additional flexibility may be required during month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closing periods.



High-performing candidates who demonstrate strong accounting accuracy, attention to detail, effective communication, consistent reliability, and timely completion of assigned responsibilities will be considered for full-time conversion, subject to business needs and position availability.



Compensation

• Range Base Pay: $7.00 – $9.00 USD per hour depending on experience.

• Performance-Based Monthly Bonus: Eligible for a monthly bonus of up to 10% of base earnings, based on demonstrated performance, accuracy and completeness of accounting records, timely completion of reconciliations and financial reporting, quality of work, client service, and achievement of established performance expectations. Bonus payments are subject to management review and discretionary approval.



About Axis Consulting LLC:

Axis Consulting LLC is a private boutique family-owned financial services firm dedicated to serving high-net-worth (HNW) and ultra-high-net-worth (UHNW) individuals, families, and privately held businesses. We specialize in providing personalized financial management, accounting, tax coordination, and family office support services tailored to the unique needs of our clients. With a focus on professionalism, discretion, and long-term relationships, our firm works closely with clients and their trusted advisors to help navigate complex financial matters, preserve generational wealth, and support their evolving financial goals. We pride ourselves on delivering attentive, high-quality service built on integrity, confidentiality, and a commitment to excellence through our professionals.



Please forward to us in a message a copy of your current resume for consideration. Also include one sentence why you should be considered for this role. Should your qualifications meet our needs for an interview, a member of our team will contact you directly. Thank you for your interest.

We are looking for a motivated, proactive, and results-driven **Business Development Representative (BDR)** to support the sales and business development efforts of two companies, **Easty and Eastbridge**.



Your primary responsibility will be to actively manage our existing sales pipelines, make outbound calls, follow up with potential clients, generate new business opportunities, and help convert leads into paying customers.



You will also work closely with leadership to schedule, prepare for, and assist with discovery calls to better understand prospective clients' needs and move opportunities through the sales process.



This is not just an appointment-setting role. We need someone who can take ownership of the pipeline, consistently engage prospects, build relationships, and contribute directly to client acquisition and revenue growth.



### Key Responsibilities



**1. Outbound Calling & Lead Generation**

- Make daily outbound calls to potential clients from existing lead lists and sales pipelines.

- Reach out to prospects through phone calls,
s, and other appropriate channels.

- Re-engage cold, inactive, and previously contacted leads.

- Identify new business opportunities and generate interest in our services.

- Confidently communicate with business owners, decision-makers, and prospective clients.

- Handle initial objections and maintain productive sales conversations.



**2. Sales Pipeline & CRM Management**

- Actively manage and organize sales pipelines for both Easty and Eastbridge.

- Monitor incoming leads and ensure timely follow-ups.

- Keep CRM records updated with accurate notes, activities, lead statuses, and next steps.

- Identify prospects who are ready to move forward in the sales process.

- Maintain consistent follow-up schedules to prevent opportunities from being missed.

- Track lead progression from initial outreach to qualified opportunities.



**3. Discovery Calls & Sales Support**

- Schedule discovery calls with qualified prospects.

- Assist leadership in conducting discovery calls with potential clients.

- Ask relevant questions to understand client needs, business challenges, goals, and requirements.

- Gather important information that will help determine the right solutions for prospects.

- Document key discussion points and coordinate next steps after discovery calls.

- Help move prospects toward proposals, closing discussions, and onboarding.



**4. Client Acquisition & Business Development**

- Build and maintain relationships with prospective clients.

- Identify opportunities to convert interested leads into paying customers.

- Follow up on proposals, pending decisions, and outstanding sales conversations.

- Support the overall client acquisition process for both companies.

- Collaborate with leadership to improve outreach strategies, follow-up processes, and conversion rates.

- Contribute to achieving monthly sales and client acquisition goals.



**5. Sales Reporting & Performance Tracking**

- Track daily calls, conversations, follow-ups, and appointments booked.

- Provide regular updates on pipeline activity and sales opportunities.

- Report lead quality, common objections, and prospect feedback.

- Monitor progress toward sales targets and key performance indicators.

- Recommend improvements to the sales process based on prospect interactions.



### Qualifications & Requirements



- Proven experience in business development, outbound sales, lead generation, appointment setting, or B2B sales.

- Excellent spoken and written English communication skills.

- Confident and comfortable making outbound calls and speaking with business owners or decision-makers.

- Experience qualifying leads, handling objections, and booking sales appointments.

- Familiarity with CRM platforms and sales pipeline management.

- Ability to support discovery calls and ask effective questions to identify client needs.

- Strong follow-up skills, attention to detail, and organizational abilities.

- Ability to manage multiple sales pipelines and prioritize tasks effectively.

- Self-motivated, resourceful, and capable of working independently.

- Comfortable working with sales targets and performance metrics.



**Preferred Qualifications**

- Experience selling services to US-based businesses.

- Previous experience working with multiple brands or business accounts.

- Familiarity with GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar CRM platforms.

- Experience supporting sales discovery calls and moving prospects through the sales cycle.

- Proven track record of generating qualified appointments or acquiring new clients.



### Who We're Looking For



We are looking for someone who is:



- **Proactive:** Takes initiative and actively looks for opportunities instead of waiting for instructions.

- **Persistent:** Consistently follows up with leads and knows how to handle rejection professionally.

- **Confident:** Comfortable starting conversations and speaking directly with decision-makers.

- **Results-Driven:** Understands that the goal is not just making calls but generating opportunities and bringing in new clients.

- **Organized:** Can effectively manage leads, follow-ups, and sales activities across two different companies.

- **Coachable:** Open to feedback and continuously improving their sales approach.

- **Accountable:** Takes ownership of assigned responsibilities and delivers consistent results.



### Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)



Success in this role will be measured through:



- Daily outbound calls and prospecting activity.

- Number of meaningful conversations with potential clients.

- Number of qualified leads generated.

- Number of discovery calls scheduled and completed.

- Follow-up consistency and CRM accuracy.

- Sales pipeline progression and conversion rates.

- New client opportunities and contribution to closed deals.



### What Success Looks Like



The ideal candidate will consistently keep both sales pipelines active, ensure leads are properly followed up with, generate qualified discovery calls, and help turn sales conversations into new business.



We want someone who can eventually take ownership of much of the day-to-day prospecting and follow-up process, allowing leadership to focus on high-value sales conversations and closing opportunities.



### How to Apply



**Submit the following to be considered:**



1. Your updated CV/Resume.

2. A 1–2 minute introduction video explaining:

   - Who you are and your relevant professional background.

   - Your experience in outbound calling, lead generation, and client acquisition.

   - Your experience working with CRM systems and sales pipelines.

   - Why you believe you are the right person for this position.



**REMINDER: BOTH REQUIREMENTS ARE MANDATORY. INCOMPLETE APPLICATIONS WILL AUTOMATICALLY BE DISQUALIFIED AND WILL NOT BE ENTERTAINED.**



We are looking for someone who is serious about sales, confident in communicating with prospects, and ready to help grow two businesses.



**If you know how to turn leads into conversations, conversations into opportunities, and opportunities into clients, we want to hear from you!**

title: AI Developer / Full-Stack Software Engineer for a U.S. AI & Web Agency (Paid Per Project + Bonus)
description:
Type of work: Project-based. You're paid per job, not by the hour.

Hours: Work your own hours. You must reply to messages the same day and be able to join a call during U.S. Pacific business hours when needed (9 AM to 5 PM Pacific, which is 1 AM to 9 AM Philippine time from November to March).

Pay: A fixed price per project, agreed before each job starts, plus bonuses later on



We're a U.S. agency that builds two things for businesses. First, websites and search work that get them found on Google, Google Maps and in AI answers. Second, custom AI systems that catch every lead that comes in and turn it into booked work. We're hiring one experienced developer who can build both, and build them well.



This is not an entry-level job. We want someone who has already built and shipped real software for real users, and can show it.



WHO WE BUILD FOR



Bigger U.S. businesses with 10 or more staff or 2 or more locations:



- Law firms

- Bigger home service companies, like HVAC, plumbing, roofing and solar

- Medical and dental clinics

- Commercial and B2B companies, like contractors, property management, logistics and manufacturers



WHAT YOU'LL BUILD



- Websites. Fast, mobile-first business websites with service pages, city pages, schema markup, and lead forms that actually reach the owner.

- AI receptionist. Answers calls, texts and web chat day and night, asks the right questions, and books the appointment on the business's calendar.

- Custom CRMs. Every lead in one place, built around how that business sells, with follow-up texts,
s and tasks that go out on a schedule.

- Lead engine. Finds businesses that look like a client's best customers, scores them, and loads them into the CRM.

- Reputation engine. Asks every finished job for a review and drafts a reply to each new review. Replies post only after the client approves them.

- Reporting dashboards. Leads, calls, booked jobs and revenue on one screen, by location and by source.

- Custom AI tools. Quote builders, intake forms, document tools, and assistants trained on a company's own files.



HOW EACH JOB WORKS



1. We send you a written brief: what to build, who it's for, and what "done" looks like.

2. We agree on a fixed price and a deadline before you start.

3. Plan it. For anything big, send a short plan before you start building.

4. Build it.

5. Test it yourself. Run it, click through it, and try to break it.

6. Put it on a preview link and send proof it works: the link, screenshots or a short screen recording.

7. Fix whatever comes back from review.

8. Once we approve it, you get paid.



On longer jobs, send a short update each day you work on it: what you finished, what's next, and anything blocking you.



HOW WE WORK



- You own the quality of everything you hand in. You understand every line of your code and can explain it.

- Never say something works until you've tested it. Show proof.

- Nothing goes live until we approve it. You build and test. We review and launch.

- Client data and passwords stay private. Use only the accounts we give you, and never paste client data or keys into outside tools or websites.

- No fake reviews, fake numbers or claims we can't prove on any client site.

- If something in a brief looks wrong, say so. Then build what we agreed on and write down your concern.



PAY



- You're paid per project, not by the hour. Before each job starts, we agree on a fixed price and what "done" means.

- You get paid when the job is done and approved. Bigger jobs are split into milestones, and you're paid as each one is approved.

- Prices go up as you prove yourself: the quality of your work, your speed, and how little hand-holding you need.

- Bonuses come later, once you've shown what you can do. They don't start on day one. We'll go over how they work when the time comes.

- It starts with a small paid test job.



WHAT YOU NEED (all of it is required)



- A college degree. Computer Science, IT or Engineering is preferred.

- At least 3 years building software for real users, at a job or for clients.

- Real past projects you can show us: live links, GitHub, or screen recordings. School projects and tutorial copies don't count.

- Strong TypeScript or JavaScript, React and Next.js, Node.js, SQL databases, APIs and webhooks, and Git.

- Real experience building AI into products: chatbots, voice agents, or tools that connect AI models (like OpenAI or Anthropic) to a company's own data.

- Business sense. You understand that a website or a CRM exists to bring in customers and book work, and you build with that in mind.

- Clear written English, and you're comfortable on video calls.

- A good computer, fast stable internet, and a backup, like a hotspot or a second line.



NICE TO HAVE



- Voice AI or phone systems (Twilio, Vapi, Retell, ElevenLabs or similar)

- Google APIs: Calendar, Business Profile, Search Console, Analytics

- SEO basics: schema markup, page speed, Core Web Vitals

- Automation tools like n8n, Make or Zapier, or CRMs like HubSpot or GoHighLevel

- Shopify development

- Working with sensitive data for medical (HIPAA) or legal clients



PLEASE DON'T APPLY IF



- You don't have a college degree.

- You don't have real past projects you can show us.

- You can't write, read and fix code on your own.

- You're an agency or a team. We're hiring one person.



HOW TO APPLY



Send all of this. Applications missing any part won't be read.



1. Put the words SHIPPED IT at the start of your subject line, so we know you read the whole post.

2. Your name, how you usually price your work, and what you would charge for each of these two jobs:

   a) a 5-page business website with a contact form

   b) a website chatbot that answers questions about a business and books appointments on Google Calendar

3. What you're best at. Your top 3 strengths as a developer, and one sentence on each.

4. Every tool you use and know how to use: languages, frameworks, databases, AI models and tools, hosting, design tools, and anything else. Mark the ones you use every day.

5. Your degree: the course, the school, and the year you graduated.

6. Your experience: where you've worked or who your clients were, for how many years, and what you built there.

7. At least 3 past projects. For each one: a live link, GitHub link or demo video, what it does, who it was for, your exact part in it, and the tech you used. If a project is private, a screen recording is fine.

8. One AI feature you built into a real product. What did it do, which AI model did you use, and what was one problem you hit and how did you fix it?

9. How you take a feature from start to finish: how you plan it, how you build it, and how you test it before you call it done.

10. A 2-minute screen recording (Loom or unlisted YouTube) where you walk us through one of your projects and explain how it works.

11. A short answer: A dental group with 3 locations misses a lot of calls after hours. In 5 sentences or less, how would you build them a system that answers those calls, asks the right questions and books the appointment? Name the tools you'd use.

12. Your resume, plus your GitHub and LinkedIn if you have them.



Shortlisted applicants do a small paid test job before we hire.



Thanks!

description:
Senior Cladding Estimator



Part-Time | Remote



We are looking for an experienced Senior Cladding Estimator to join our team on a part-time, fully remote basis.



We're specifically looking for someone with strong hands-on experience estimating Australian cladding projects. This is not a general estimating position or for junior estimators — cladding experience is essential.



Minimum Requirements:



-Minimum 2 years' experience estimating Australian cladding projects

-Strong experience completing detailed cladding takeoffs and estimates

-Good understanding of Australian building plans, specifications and construction details

-Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

-Strong attention to detail and accuracy

-Reliable and able to consistently meet deadlines

-Good written and spoken English

-Available for part-time remote work

-Experience in roofing estimating will be highly regarded



You should be confident estimating items such as:



-Metal wall cladding (Colorbond, standing seam, interlocking panels, etc.)

-Render finishes including substrate types

-Fibre cement cladding (James Hardie, CSR and similar systems)

-Aluminium cladding panels and architectural cladding systems

-Timber and composite cladding systems

-Flashings, cappings, corners and trims

-Sarking, wall wraps, insulation and weatherproofing components

-Software

-Experience using software such as PlanSwift, Bluebeam, CostX, Cubit or similar will be considered a strong advantage.



The Role



You'll be responsible for reviewing project documentation, completing detailed cladding takeoffs and preparing estimates for Australian cladding contractors.



The role is:



-Part-time with possibility of Full-time after probation

-100% remote

-Ongoing for the right person

title: DTC E-Com Video Editor / Creative Strategist
description:
DTC E-Commerce Video Editor / Creative Strategist (Long-Term, High Volume)



We're looking for a highly skilled DTC video editor with strong creative strategy instincts, not someone who simply cuts clips, adds subtitles, and calls it an ad.



We need someone who understands direct-response advertising, visual storytelling, audience psychology, and retention. You should be able to read a script, understand the message behind every line, and independently choose visuals that make the ad more engaging, convincing, and effective.



This is consistent, high-volume work with opportunities for a long-term partnership.



Strict Prerequisites — Please Read Before Applying



1. Proven DTC E-Commerce Ad Experience (Required)



You MUST have experience editing direct-response ads for
, Instagram, or TikTok.



We're NOT looking for wedding editors, music video editors, cinematic filmmakers, gaming editors, or generic short-form editors without performance advertising experience.



Your portfolio must contain actual DTC product advertisements, preferably 60–150-second ads.



2. Strong Visual Storytelling & Creative Judgment



This is our biggest requirement.



You must be able to read a script and independently determine what footage would communicate each line most effectively.



For example, if the script says:



"His legs grew faster than his coordination could keep up."



We DON'T want generic footage of kids exercising or a random soccer training montage.



We want footage that visually demonstrates the actual idea, such as a young player struggling to coordinate a sudden change of direction.



You must understand the difference between footage that is simply related to a topic and footage that actually communicates the intended message.



3. Proactive, Creative Execution — Not Lazy Editing



We DON'T want:



Endless generic stock footage or random B-roll.



Static clips with subtitles as the only editing.



Repetitive talking heads with no visual variation.



Unnecessary flashy transitions that add no meaning.



Random clips chosen because their titles contain relevant keywords.



Editors who need detailed instructions for every single visual.



We DO want:



Purposeful B-roll showing real-life situations, demonstrations, emotional reactions, and physical problems.



Dynamic pacing, natural zooms, relevant close-ups, visual comparisons, and pattern interrupts.



Creative use of diagrams, annotations, motion graphics, and simple visual explanations when appropriate.



Strong visual hooks and retention-focused editing throughout the ad.



Someone who can make educational explanations visually interesting without turning everything into generic stock footage.



4. Understand Direct-Response Creative Strategy



You should understand how to visually communicate:



Hooks: Stop the scroll in the first 3 seconds.



Problems: Make viewers recognize their own frustrations.



Mechanisms: Visually explain why a problem happens.



Demonstrations: Show rather than simply tell.



Transformations: Communicate the desired outcome through compelling visuals.



Retention: Introduce meaningful visual changes and curiosity throughout longer videos.



You don't need to write our scripts, but you MUST understand how to turn them into compelling advertisements.



5. Fast Execution & High Volume



We're looking for someone with an efficient workflow who can consistently produce quality edits without spending days on a single video.



Experience with AI-assisted editing, B-roll sourcing, automated captions, or other time-saving tools is a plus.



Speed matters, but irrelevant footage and rushed, low-effort edits are unacceptable.



What We Provide



Complete scripts and voiceovers.



Creative references and examples.



Product information and audience research.



Clear feedback and ongoing work.



You will be responsible for sourcing suitable footage, selecting visuals, editing, captions, sound design, and final delivery.



Application Requirements



Please include:



Portfolio: Send 3–5 actual DTC e-commerce ads you've personally edited. No wedding videos, music videos, or unrelated reels.



Pricing: Your rate per 60–150-second video and discounted bulk pricing for 10–20+ videos.



Turnaround: How many hours does a typical 90-second ad take you to complete?



Capacity: How many finished videos can you deliver weekly?



Creative judgment test: If a script says "The heel cups stopped the pain during practice, but he was limping again by dinner," describe the specific visuals you would use to communicate this in a 5–8-second sequence.



Applications without relevant DTC examples or an answer to the creative judgment test will not be considered.



We're looking for a creative thinker who happens to be a fast editor, not simply someone who knows how to use editing software.

title: Senior GTM Engineer
description:
We're a LinkedIn outreach agency that helps B2B companies generate meetings at scale. We manage ~3000 LinkedIn accounts, run outreach campaigns, and book calls for our clients. 



We're looking for a Senior GTM Engineer to own lead sourcing, list building, and campaign infrastructure. You'll be the person who figures out how to find the right people, build the data sets, and make sure our outreach hits the right inboxes -especially when the obvious routes don't work.



What you'll do

• Build and maintain targeted lead lists for outreach campaigns across a range of industries and verticals

• Source leads creatively when conventional databases and filters fall short - scraping, enrichment, intent signals, community mining, event attendee lists, whatever gets results

• Set up and manage the technical infrastructure behind our campaigns - tools, integrations, data pipelines, CRM hygiene

• Work closely with the outreach team to refine targeting based on campaign performance and reply quality

• Identify patterns in what's converting and feed that back into how we build lists and select audiences

• Own data quality end to end - deduplication, validation, enrichment, deliverability checks

What we're looking for

• Proven experience in B2B lead sourcing and list building, ideally for an outreach or lead gen agency

• Strong technical chops - comfortable with scraping tools, APIs, enrichment platforms, and automation workflows

• Someone who's resourceful and persistent when the easy methods don't surface the right people

• Familiarity with LinkedIn outreach tooling and the ecosystem around it is a strong plus

• Able to work independently, manage your own priorities, and communicate clearly on progress and blockers

Compensation

Up to $5,000 per annum for the right person.

How to apply

Skip the generic pitch. Instead, answer this:

Tell us about the most initiative you've ever shown in sourcing a tricky lead list that conventional methods wouldn't work for. What was the target audience? Why were they hard to find? What did you actually do - step by step - to build the list? What was the result?

We're not looking for a polished essay. We want to see how you think when the standard playbook doesn't apply. If you've never had to get creative to find people, this probably isn't the right role.

Thank you

• Repairs administration: maintain a dated record of tenant repair reports, photographs, decisions, appointments and outcomes. Obtain initial information, prepare drafts, coordinate tenant access when instructed and follow up for completion evidence. The landlord will normally select contractors, discuss work directly and approve quotations and expenditure. You will contact contractors or arrange work only when instructed or under an agreed routine procedure.

• Administer routine compliance appointments, such as annual gas-safety checks, using approved contractors and documented procedures. Escalate failures, remedial work, costs and uncertainties.

• Coordinate arrears follow-up using payment information supplied by our finance colleague.

• Prepare approved tenant letters, rent-review paperwork and draft formal notices for the landlord's review.

• Monitor relevant changes, including Renters' Rights Act processes and government rental-property registration requirements as they become applicable.

• Provide a concise weekly report covering outstanding matters, upcoming deadlines and decisions required.

• Depending on portfolio needs, assist with Airbnb or short-let guest communication and approved outreach to potential business clients.



New lettings and tenancy setup



When a property needs letting, you will coordinate advertising, enquiries, local viewings, referencing, Right to Rent checks, current tenancy documentation, deposit administration, prescribed information and move-in arrangements.



You will develop and maintain a checklist using current NRLA, 
 and relevant council guidance, tailored to each property and tenancy. Every step should identify its deadline, responsible person, required evidence, completion date and any approval needed.



Systems and resources



We have NRLA membership, including guidance, templates, checklists and access to advice, as well as other landlord resources. We are considering NRLA Portfolio but have not yet selected or configured the final management system.



Routine physical letters may be sent remotely using an approved service. Serious legal documents will be reviewed and handled by the landlord, with copies, posting evidence and follow-up retained in the records.



Potential future responsibility



If we develop a “sell my house quickly” enquiry portal, the role may later include maintaining records of homeowners contacted, setting follow-up reminders, preparing and sending approved follow-ups, and flagging enquiries requiring the landlord's attention. Tenancy management, licensing and compliance will remain the main priorities, and hours will be reviewed if this additional work grows.



Experience and working arrangements



Direct experience supporting UK landlords or letting agencies—particularly English residential tenancies—is strongly preferred. Excellent written English, careful record-keeping, initiative, sound judgement and reliable follow-through are essential.



We anticipate approximately 5–15 hours per week. Hours will vary according to workload and are not guaranteed. The initial setup period, new lettings and significant compliance projects may require additional time. If the work is likely to exceed 15 hours in any week, this must be raised with us and approved in advance before any additional hours are worked.



Administrative work can be completed flexibly. However, communication with tenants, contractors, Airbnb or short-let guests and prospective business clients must take place during appropriate UK working hours. You must also be available for agreed training and meetings with some UK-hours overlap.



This role requires prompt, dependable communication. You must acknowledge work messages, confirm agreed meetings, answer all questions in a message and notify us in advance of any delay or availability issue.



Pay is US$5 per hour for actual time spent on assigned or agreed tasks, tracked through Hubstaff. This is intended as an ongoing, variable-hours part-time role rather than a full-time position.



The landlord will approve tenants, rents, contractors, significant expenditure, remedial works and formal legal action. Local contractors or agents will handle physical visits and works. You must recognise when specialist or legal advice is required.



To apply, please answer these questions:



1. Describe your direct experience with UK residential property, landlords or letting agencies. Which tenancy and compliance tasks have you personally handled?

2. How would you create an auditable system showing each obligation, deadline, responsible person, evidence and completion date?

3. If asked whether a property needs a council licence, how would you research and document the answer?

4. Give an example of a repair, tenant issue or compliance matter that you followed through from first report to verified completion.

5. What are your current work commitments, and what exact hours can you provide during UK working hours?

6. What backup arrangements do you have for internet or power interruptions?

7. Please confirm that you understand and accept the US$5 hourly rate and variable workload of approximately 5–15 hours per week.



Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a short paid practical assessment.

title: Fluent Mandarin and English Executive and Operations Assistant for a Toronto Tutoring Company
description:
ABOUT EXPLORING SCHOLAR

Exploring Scholar is a tutoring company based in Toronto, Ontario. Most of our families are English and Mandarin speaking, and our weekends are our busiest time. We are looking for a sharp, reliable assistant to work directly with the owner and act as the central point of coordination across our teachers, staff, and operations.

 

THE ROLE

This is not a standard admin or call-center job. You will work side by side with the owner, take the growing to-do list off their plate, and make sure things actually get done. You will coordinate between teams, follow up on open items, and keep everything moving. You will not be the main person answering every parent call or booking every class, but you will be the person who keeps it all connected.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Act as the central coordination point between the owner, teachers, and staff

- Turn the owner's instructions into a clear, prioritized to-do list, then work through it one task at a time

- Execute on tasks quickly and correctly, with minimal follow-up needed

- Write clear SOPs (standard operating procedures) from the instructions and examples the owner gives you

- Support teacher recruitment and onboarding

- Communicate in Mandarin with our Mandarin-speaking staff member and, when needed, with Mandarin-speaking families

- Step in on phone, WeChat, and scheduling tasks when the owner needs support

- Keep shared documents, trackers, and records organized in Google Workspace

 

MUST HAVES

- Fluent spoken and written Mandarin AND fluent spoken and written English. Both languages are mandatory, and you will be assessed on both.

- Proven experience as an executive assistant, operations assistant, or similar role

- Proven experience working night shifts as a remote worker

- Fast learner who picks up new tools and processes quickly

- Able to juggle many tasks at once and coordinate multiple people without dropping details

- Strong written communication, and able to document processes clearly

- Comfortable with Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Gmail, Calendar, Drive)

- Very comfortable using AI tools in your everyday work, and able to tell us your skill level and give real examples of how you use them

- Comfortable on the phone and with WeChat

- Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet workspace, a computer, and a headset, with a backup plan for power or internet outages

- Available during the coverage hours listed below

 

NICE TO HAVES

- Experience in education, tutoring, or a service business

- Experience with Chinese-language customer support or a bilingual BPO

- Experience building SOPs or training materials

 

SCHEDULE

- Full-time engagement, about 8 billable hours per day

- 12:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. Toronto time (hours follow Toronto's clock, including daylight saving changes), with a one-hour unpaid break

- Thursday to Monday, with Tuesday and Wednesday off (flexible weekday rest day).

- This is an overnight shift in the Philippines, so please only apply if this works for you long term

 

COMPENSATION

- Monthly rate of CAD $1,700 to $2,400, depending on experience

- Paid monthly through Wise, at the beginning of the following month for the full previous calendar month

- A 13th month payment after one full year of working together

 

ENGAGEMENT TYPE

This is an independent contractor engagement under a written service agreement. You are responsible for your own taxes and registrations, you provide your own computer, headset, and internet, and you send a simple invoice each month.

 

HOW TO APPLY

To be considered, please send all of the following. Applications without these will not be reviewed.

 

1. Your resume and a short note on why you fit this role

2. A Loom video of no more than 5 minutes in which you: introduce yourself in Mandarin and then in English; describe your comfort level with AI tools (beginner, intermediate, or advanced), the tools you use, and one specific time AI dramatically increased your efficiency at work; describe a time you built an SOP or took a messy to-do list and got it done; and confirm you can work 12:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. Toronto time, Thursday to Monday

3. Your expected monthly rate in Canadian dollars

 

Start your application with the word "Scholar" so we know you read the whole post.

 

HIRING PROCESS



1. Stage 1, application review

2. Stage 2, practical task: shortlisted applicants receive a realistic scenario and record a second Loom video of up to 5 minutes, sharing their screen while they work. You will be given a messy list of owner requests with conflicting priorities. Show us how you would turn it into a prioritized plan, draft a short SOP for one of the requests from a few rough bullet points, and write one short WeChat reply in Mandarin to a parent whose class was cancelled. Talk through your thinking out loud as you go, and show us how you use AI tools during the task if you choose to.

3. Stage 3, live interview: the top candidates have a live phone or video interview that includes a conversation in English and Mandarin

title: Engineering Team Coordinator (Delivery & Execution)
description:
We are seeking an Engineering team coordinator who can own predictable delivery across engineering by enforcing sprint discipline, decision clarity, and execution standards. Reduce coordination cost, eliminate rework, and ensure that engineering output is reviewable, shippable, and on time.



Core Responsibilities



Sprint Ownership & Delivery Control

• Own sprint planning, execution, and closure

• Enforce sprint scope boundaries (no silent mid-sprint additions)

• Ensure all tickets entering a sprint meet Definition of Ready

• Track and act on: ticket aging, spillover, churn, blocked work

• Move tickets aggressively across states (TODO ? IN PROGRESS ? REVIEW ? DONE)

• Kill zombie tickets



Timebox Enforcement

• Treat timeboxes as coordination contracts, not estimates

• Require proactive communication before a timebox slips

• Block review if timebox standards are violated

• Escalate early, not after the fact



Execution Quality Gates

• Enforce: Definition of Ready (before sprint), Definition of Done (before release)

• Reject work that: contains implicit decisions, lacks acceptance criteria, introduces duplication without approval

• Ensure code review happens before QA

• Ensure QA does not compensate for missing engineering clarity



Decision Discipline (in partnership with TPM / Product)

• Require explicit tracking of: Open Decisions, Frozen Decisions

• Block execution on unresolved architectural decisions

• Ensure decisions are made by the right group, at the right time

• Prevent “decision by implementation”



5. Engineering Standards Enforcement

• Enforce agreed standards consistently: no duplication without approval, no implicit architecture decisions, no skipping ticket states

• Treat violations as delivery risk, not personal issues

• Track repeat violations and escalate



Required Skills & Traits



Must Have

• Strong judgment around delivery tradeoffs

• Comfort enforcing rules and saying “no”

• Ability to stop work and force alignment

• Low tolerance for ambiguity in execution

• Bias for early escalation over late heroics

• Calm under pressure, emotionally neutral

• Experience running sprints that actually ship

• Strong English language skills

• Familiarity with Jira-style workflows



Nice to Have

• Background as senior engineer

• Experience in SaaS / platform teams

• Worked alongside TPMs or Product Managers

Amazon A+ Content and Brand Store

- Track product dispatches, deadlines, content submissions and required revisions.

- Follow up consistently on outstanding deliverables.

- Organise approved influencer content so that it can be reused across social media, advertising and other marketing channels.

- Help identify suitable brand collaborations and partnership opportunities.



 marketing responsibilities

Shortlisted applicants will be invited to an interview and may be asked to complete a short paid practical assessment involving a campaign concept, social or advertising graphic, and an Amazon A+ or brochure-design task.

Work-from-home opportunity

title: Appointment Setter for US Med Spas (Botox and Filler), Pick Your Own Hours, $5 per Booking
description:
Systemize is a US growth agency for med spas. We run Botox and filler ads for clinics across the US. When someone fills out a form, our booking team calls them and books them in.



We're hiring several appointment setters to join that team.



Every lead is warm. You only call people who just asked about Botox or filler. No cold calling.



WHAT YOU DO

- New leads post in our 
. When you're online, you grab one and call within 5 minutes.

- You call from the clinic's own US number, in our web dialer. Never your personal phone.

- Run a short, friendly consultation: what they want done, if they've had it before, and what worries them.

- Book them into the clinic's calendar with a deposit. You text them a secure payment link while you stay on the line.

- Send reminder texts so they show up.

- Log every call, text and booking in our CRM.



We're one team for every clinic. Any setter can call any lead for any clinic. You never give medical advice. We train you on exactly what to say.



PAY

- $5 for every appointment you book with a deposit. No base pay.

- No cap. 10 bookings is $50. 100 bookings is $500.

- Paid monthly. A booking counts unless the patient cancels and gets the deposit back.



HOURS

You pick your own hours. We need 1 to 2 setters online at all times from 8 AM to 10 PM US time (mostly US Central), 7 days a week.



In Philippine time that's 10 PM to 12 noon the next day. From mid March to early November the US moves its clocks, so it's 9 PM to 11 AM.



Tell us which hours and days you'll work. Then show up for them.



WHAT YOU NEED

- Clear, warm spoken English.

- A quiet, private room. Patients share private things.

- Internet of 25 Mbps or more, plus a backup like mobile data.

- A computer and a headset with a mic.

- 
 on your phone or computer.

- A plus: phone sales, appointment setting or front desk experience. Clinic, salon or skin care is even better.



WHAT WE GIVE YOU

- Warm leads from ads we run.

- Full training: our call playbook, Botox and filler basics, and what you can and can't say.

- A CRM login, the web dialer, and each clinic's info and calendar.



HOW TO APPLY (3 steps)

1. Start your subject line with the word DEPOSIT, then your full name. Example: DEPOSIT Maria Santos

2. Record a voice note, 60 to 90 seconds, on 
 (free, no sign up) and paste the link in your message. Use the headset you'd work with. In the recording:

   - Tell us who you are and about your last job talking to customers on the phone (about 45 seconds).

   - Then leave this voi
 like it's real: Sarah asked about Botox at Glow Med Spa 2 minutes ago. You called her twice. She didn't pick up. Leave her the voi
 you'd leave (15 to 30 seconds).

3. In your message, tell us your city, which hours and days you'll work (Philippine time), your internet speed, and when you can start.



If your subject line doesn't start with DEPOSIT, we won't open it.
