ROLE OVERVIEW

Bk1zzle is hiring a Lead YouTube Editor to own our post production process . This is a hands-on role where you set the standard for quality, speed, and creative judgment across every piece of content we publish.

You’ll lead all long form edits, review work from other editors, and make sure every piece of content that goes live feels intentional and on brand. You will train new editors, build and optimize workflow and systems, and build clear SOPs that keep the whole process running smoothly.



If you’re the type who understands educational content and editing at a high level, loves being in a timeline, and knows how to elevate the people around you, you’ll do well in this role. This is a leadership position for someone who cares about craft, process, and developing the team.



RESPONSIBILITIES:



Content Strategy & Execution:

- Own the full post production pipeline for YouTube

- Shape story, pacing, and structure of every long-form video to maximize retention

- Cut raw footage into tight, engaging educational edits that feel clean, intentional, and aligned with the brand

- Craft strong intros that match packaging, titles, and thumbnails

- Maintain a consistent upload schedule and predictable delivery (and on time) schedule for edits from the team

- Ensure every video is optimized for audience retention, clarity, and watchability for our core audience 



Platform Strategy & Brand Alignment:

- Stay fluent in YouTube best practices, retention principles, packaging strategy, and viewer behavior

- Understand what makes content feel native to YouTube and adjust editing decisions accordingly

- Protect the brand voice and quality across all edits

- Support ongoing format evolution so the channel stays fresh and competitive

- Suggest creative ideas, experiments, and improvements based on performance



Analytics & Optimization:

- Track performance through YouTube Studio and supporting tools

- Review key metrics to make informed decisions  (retention curves, AVD, CTR, new audience reach and more)

- Optimize editing, video ideas, and structure based on data

- Run simple weekly and monthly reports that help drive creative and strategic decisions

- Identify trends early and propose experiments to improve performance

- Use data to reduce revision cycles and increase efficiency across the team



RESULTS (KPIs & Success Metrics):

Quarter-over-quarter improvement in:

- Average view duration

- Retention in the first 30 seconds per video

- Average views per video

- Total leads from long-form content

- A reliable, repeatable editing and publishing system that runs clean without needing heavy oversight

- Consistent output resulting in 8 long-form YouTube uploads per month

- All files, assets, and project timelines stay organized

- Weekly and quarterly reports that highlight key metrics

- Editors consistently hit their quarterly KPIs

- On-time delivery rate for long-form projects stays above 85%



REQUIREMENTS:

- Curiosity around the subject matter Founder/CEO talks about

- 4+ years of experience editing long-form YouTube content for founders, online creators, or personal brands

- Deep understanding of YouTube as a platform, including retention fundamentals, packaging, and audience behavior

- Deeply understands the difference between entertainment and education content

- Strong proficiency in Adobe Premiere, After Effects, Adobe Suite, and other editing tools

- Proven ability to shape long-form educational content with clean pacing, strong storytelling, and tight structure

- Ability to give and receive feedback, iterate quickly, and deliver reliably within deadlines

- Experience managing editors, giving notes, and project management

- Experience using tools like 
 and AI tools that improve editing workflows

- Eagerness to experiment with new tools, formats, and editing approaches to stay ahead

- Organized, detail-oriented, and able to maintain clean file structures and predictable project flows

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where clarity, speed, and communication matter

​​

Bonus if you have:

title: Operations and Reporting Coordinator
description:
Operations and Reporting Coordinator

Full-time, remote. Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 5:00pm US Central (10:00pm to 7:00am Manila time from November to March; 9:00pm to 6:00am from March to November). Reports to Operations Lead.



ABOUT LUX & NYX

Lux & Nyx designs architectural handbags for professional women who refuse to choose between style and function. Featured in Forbes, Refinery29, NPR, and Marie Claire. We sell across Shopify DTC, Amazon, Nordstrom, and Macy's, and through a corporate gifting channel. Remote-first team led by founder Lisa Hu.



THE ROLE

You'll keep the back end of our business right: the numbers we d
 on, the products we list, and every order after the customer clicks Buy. You'll prepare our daily sales and ads reports, be our warehouse's main contact, answer our customers, and keep our listings and catalogs accurate on every channel. You'll work closely with Michelle, who leads operations, and take vendor follow-up and day-to-day execution off her plate.



This role is half care and half precision. You need to be warm with a customer and politely persistent with a vendor, and you need to refuse to upload, send or pay anything when a number doesn't match its source. The most valuable thing you do is catch the mistake before it goes live.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

• Reporting: prepare our daily sales report and marketing ads reports, check every number against its source, and flag anything that doesn't add up.

• Orders and the warehouse: keep orders moving across our store, Amazon and retail partners, be our warehouse's main contact, check the returns, files and invoices it sends us, and follow up with vendors until every issue is closed.

• Customer care and reviews: answer customers within one business day, warmly and in our brand voice, including refunds, returns and warranty claims, and look after our product reviews.

• Inventory and listings: keep stock files, product listings, our ESP and SAGE corporate gifting catalogs and approved promotions accurate on every channel, checked against our master sheet.

• Production support: get our weekly production meeting ready, and prepare purchase orders, packing lists and shipping documents from approved inputs.

• Returns and tickets: reconcile returns and refunds, and follow every open support ticket until it's fixed.

• Systems and SOPs: write down every step you own, keep our trackers current, help set up new sales channels, and run the automations we approve.



Not part of this role: pricing, budget and other financial decisions, paid ads management, forecasting, corporate gifting quotes and orders (another teammate owns those), running the warehouse floor, product design, and accounting.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• You stop rather than upload. If a count, price or SKU doesn't match its source, nothing goes live until it does. That's the number one thing.

• You can trace every number. Ask where a figure came from and you can show the source. You're comfortable with totals, per-unit costs and variances.

• You work it out yourself. AI can help you draft or double-check, but the thinking and the judgment are yours.

• 2+ years reconciling or reporting operational data: inventory, orders and invoices, e-commerce reporting, or marketplace operations.

• Hands-on e-commerce listing experience: Amazon flat files, retailer portals or Shopify product setup, including fixing rejected or suppressed listings.

• Customer care for an online brand: order questions, refunds, returns and warranty claims, written warmly and clearly.

• Strong spreadsheet skills: formulas, lookups and reconciliations.

• Clear, polished written English, and steady follow-through without anyone having to chase you.

• A builder: when something was never written down, you write it down and make it the standard.

• Here for the long haul: you want to own this work and get great at it.



A strong plus: Mirakl, ShipStation, ESP or SAGE catalogs, retailer vendor portals, EDI, packing lists and carton planning, or working day to day with a warehouse.



You don't need every box ticked. If you catch the mistake before it goes live and you can show where every number came from, we want to hear from you.



WHAT GREAT LOOKS LIKE

• Every report goes out on time and matches its source.

• Customers hear back within one business day.

• Every listing and catalog matches our master sheet.

• Every open vendor issue and support ticket has a next step.

• Every recurring step is written down.



PAY AND BENEFITS

US$600 to $1,300 a month depending on experience, plus a performance bonus. Paid PTO. Health stipend. Weekly 1:1 with Michelle, async-first on Slack.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply right here on OnlineJobs.ph. Your application must do three things:



1. Start with the word TRACE.

2. Answer this in your own words: It's Monday, December 21. Tomorrow at 10:00am US Central you upload the Amazon available-to-sell file. Last Friday's inventory file shows 448 units of the Belt Bag in Black. On Saturday, 30 units shipped on a corporate order. Today's warehouse count shows 412 units. 12 customer returns arrived Friday and haven't been inspected yet. The warehouse is closed Thursday and Friday for Christmas. What number would you upload, what do you check before you do, who do you tell, and by when?

3. Include your resume, or a Google Drive link to it that opens.



Applications missing any of the three won't be reviewed. Those three steps are deliberate: they show us, before we ever meet, whether you read carefully and own the details.



NEXT STEPS

If you're shortlisted: a short form and a recorded video intro, then a paid skills test, then a call with our founder where you'll walk us through some of your answers. Then an offer.

* U.S. working hours, including at least one weekend day

* $5 USD per hour plus performance-based commissions

* Training, scripts, feedback, and ongoing sales development provided



## How to Apply



Begin your application with the words **“CHAT SETTER”** and include:



1. A brief description of your chat sales or appointment-setting experience.

2. The largest number of leads or active conversations you have managed.

3. The platforms and CRMs you have used.

4. Your availability in U.S. Eastern Time.

> “I’m interested, but I’m not ready to book a call. Can you just tell me how much it costs?”



We are looking closely at your ability to write naturally, ask good questions, stay organized, and move a conversation forward.

title: Video Editor — Storytelling, Interviews & B2B Content
description:
Remote | Project-Based / Part-Time as Needed | Long-Term Opportunity



About Us



We're a Canada-based video production business creating story-driven video content for companies and organizations.



Our projects include brand stories, client testimonials, interviews, educational content, and short-form videos for B2B companies and nonprofit organizations.



We're looking for an experienced video editor to collaborate with us on a project-by-project basis, with the potential for a long-term working relationship.



This is not a position focused on trendy TikTok edits or high-volume social media content. We're looking for someone who understands storytelling and knows how to turn real conversations into engaging, meaningful videos.



What We're Looking For



1. Strong English comprehension and proven interview storytelling experience — essential



This is our number one priority.



You must have previous experience independently editing interview-driven videos and building stories from raw footage. We're not looking for someone who needs to learn the fundamentals of storytelling from scratch.



You should be able to:



- Understand English-language interviews, including different accents, natural speech, and complex business topics.

- Review raw interviews and independently identify the strongest ideas, quotes, and meaningful moments.

- Build a compelling story arc based on the video's purpose, audience, and key message.

- Turn long conversations into clear, engaging narratives without changing the speaker's intended meaning.

- Recognize what to cut, what to keep, and where a pause or transition helps the story.

- Explain your editorial choices and suggest improvements when something isn't working.



You should already have your own approach to reviewing interviews, selecting footage, and developing a narrative.



We'll provide creative briefs, project context, brand guidelines, and direction. We're also happy to share our internal workflow and collaborate on improving the process, but we expect you to bring established editorial skills and independent creative judgment.



2. A modern, refined editing style



Our work sits somewhere between traditional corporate video and contemporary digital storytelling.



We want videos that feel professional, polished, and credible, but never generic, outdated, or overly corporate.



We're looking for an editor with a strong creative eye who understands:



- Thoughtful pacing and engaging visual storytelling.

- Creative and purposeful use of B-roll.

- Clean, tasteful motion graphics and animation.

- Smooth transitions that feel intentional rather than distracting.

- Music selection that supports the story and avoids generic corporate soundtracks.

- Strong sound design and audio mixing.

- Consistent, professional color correction and grading.



We value creativity and attention to detail, but we don't believe every video needs flashy effects, constant zooms, or excessive animation.



Every creative decision should serve the story.



3. Technical skills and reliability



- Experience with DaVinci Resolve preferred.

- Comfortable working with multicamera interviews and separate audio recordings.

- Ability to organize footage, project files, and deliverables.

- Comfortable working from creative briefs, brand guidelines, and reference videos.

- Strong attention to detail and quality control.

- Clear communication in written English.

- Ability to work independently, ask thoughtful questions, and meet agreed deadlines.

- Willingness to receive feedback and collaborate through revisions.



 What You'll Be Working On



Projects may include:



- Interview-driven B2B videos.

- Brand stories and company profiles.

- Client testimonials and case studies.

- Nonprofit and community impact stories.

- Educational and thought-leadership content.

- Short-form videos adapted from longer interviews.



Some projects will come with a prepared rough cut and will require final editing, B-roll, graphics, sound design, and color grading.



Other projects may involve reviewing raw interview footage, selecting the strongest material, and developing an initial story structure.



 Working Arrangement



This is a remote, project-based opportunity, not a full-time position.



We're currently looking for an additional editor to support our production workload as projects come up. Work volume may vary from month to month, so consistent weekly hours are not guaranteed.



Our goal is to build a reliable, long-term collaboration with someone who cares about quality, storytelling, and the creative process.



Compensation: The hourly rate listed is a starting reference. We're open to discussing rates based on your experience, skill level, and the scope of each project. Both hourly and project-based arrangements are possible.



How to Apply



Please include:



1. 2–3 complete video projects that best demonstrate your storytelling and editing skills. Interview-based, documentary-style, branded, or educational content is especially relevant. Please don't send only a showreel.

2. A short explanation of your specific role in those projects. Did you select the interview clips and build the story, or were you working from a prepared script or rough cut?

3. Your experience working with English-language interviews and building narratives from raw footage.

4. Your editing software and typical workflow.

5. Your hourly rate in USD and whether you're open to project-based work.



Please note: Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a small paid editing test using provided footage.



We're looking for someone with a strong editorial instinct, a modern creative perspective, and genuine attention to detail — someone who understands that great editing isn't just about how a video looks, but how effectively it communicates a story.

**Monthly Salary: ₱20,000–₱25,000**

- Your demonstrated skills and technical capabilities.

- Your ability to perform the responsibilities of the position.

- Your relevant practical knowledge and experience.

We are looking for someone who understands the basics of the industry and can communicate professionally with clients, handle incoming calls, and coordinate effectively with our internal team.



The ideal candidate has a friendly and neutral accent, excellent phone communication skills, and the ability to provide a positive client experience while keeping daily operations organized.



Key Responsibilities:

- Answer incoming calls professionally, assist with general inquiries, and direct calls to the appropriate departments or team members.

- Provide friendly and professional customer service to clients and callers.

- Coordinate communication between clients and internal team members to ensure requests and concerns are properly addressed.

- Schedule meetings, manage calendars, and keep appointment details up to date.

- Track follow-ups, pending requests, and important tasks to ensure nothing gets missed.

- Keep clients and internal staff informed and aligned on schedules, meeting details, and next steps.

- Maintain organized digital documents, records, and schedules.

- Provide general administrative and office coordination support as needed.



We're Looking for Someone Who Has:

- Previous experience or educational background in accounting, taxation, bookkeeping, or the tax industry. This is a key requirement for the role.

- Experience in customer service, handling incoming calls, receptionist duties, or client support.

- Excellent verbal communication and phone etiquette.

- A friendly, professional, and neutral accent that is easily understood by US-based clients.

- Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate confidently and professionally over the phone.

- Good coordination and organizational skills, with the ability to follow up on tasks and communicate effectively with different team members.

- Experience with document management, scheduling, calendar management, or administrative support.

- Familiarity with Slack and Microsoft Teams.

- The ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and handle confidential client information.

- A reliable and professional approach to handling client communications.



Work Setup:

Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9 AM – 6 PM Eastern Time

Employment Type: Full-time

Location: Work from home



Required home office setup:

- A reliable computer

- Stable, high-speed internet connection

title: Cold Caller & Cold Email Outreach / Appointment Setter for US Real Estate Media
description:
Landing Nest Media is a growing real estate media company in Massachusetts and New Hampshire, USA. We create listing photos, video, drone, and floor plans for top real estate agents, as well as do personal branding. We are hiring an outreach specialist to join our sales team: you will cold call AND cold
 real estate agents and book appointments for us.



This is a real position on a growing team, with training, scripts, templates, and target client lists. If you are confident on the phone, sharp in writing, and you like hitting targets, keep reading.



What you will do

- Make 100 outbound cold calls per day to real estate agents in our market. You build your daily call list from Zillow and 
 using our criteria (agents with active listings that are missing key media, like video or a 3D tour), and you will also work a Top 200 agent list that we provide

- Run cold
 outreach to agents using our templates and tools: send the sequences, watch for replies, and work every interested reply toward a booked call

- Follow our proven call script: introduce Landing Nest Media, ask about their current listing photos and video, and find what their listings are missing

- Book follow-up calls and shoots on our system (Tonomo)

- Log every call outcome in our CRM (GoHighLevel) the same day

- Check the CRM before you contact any agent, and keep every agent record current. Each agent has exactly one owner on our team, so no agent is ever contacted by two of us, and existing clients are never cold called

- Send short follow-up texts to agents between calls using our templates

- Stay in contact with the clients you bring in, like a client success manager: check in with them, keep the relationship warm, and help them book again. Your commission depends on their repeat bookings (see pay structure), so this is part of the job, not extra.

- Report your numbers daily: dials, conversations,
s sent, replies, bookings



Our benchmark from top performers in this exact role: 100 dials leads to about 25 real conversations and 1 to 5 bookings per day. We care about conversations and bookings, not just dials.



What we provide

- Your target criteria and a Top 200 agent list (you build your daily list from Zillow and 
), call scripts,
 templates, and objection handling training

- First-week training directly with the company owner

- CRM and dialer access

- Daily coaching and feedback from our team

- A clear scoreboard so you always know where you stand



What we need from you

- Fluent, clear spoken English suitable for US business calls

- Strong written English for cold
: clean grammar, short sentences, professional tone

- Experience in cold calling, cold
 outreach, telemarketing, or appointment setting (real estate experience is a plus, not required)

- Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet workspace, and a good headset

- Comfortable working US Eastern Time hours, starting at 9:00 AM ET (this is a night shift from the Philippines)

- Thick skin, high energy, and coachable: you will get feedback and we expect it applied the same day

- Stable and looking for long-term work, not short gigs



Pay and structure

- $4/hour USD, paid biweekly (via Wise)

- Pay growth, built in: raise to $5/hour at 90 days. Raise to $6/hour at 13 months if you have consistently hit your 100 calls a day on every working day (weekdays only; no weekend work in this role)

- Commission on the clients you lock in, paid on what they book:

  - Their 1st shoot: 100% of the shoot value. If they book a $600 shoot, you earn $600.

  - Their 2nd shoot: 15% commission

  - Their 3rd shoot: 10% commission

  - Their 4th shoot: 5% commission

  - After the 4th shoot: no further commission on that client

- Why it works this way: we want you keeping your clients happy and rebooking, like a client success manager, and we want you always hunting new clients too. Worked example on a client who books four $600 shoots: you earn $600 + $90 + $60 + $30 = $780 from that one client.

- Commission timing: commission is earned and paid after the client's payment for that shoot has been received. A booking that cancels or never pays earns no commission.



How to apply

Reply with:

1. A 1-2 minute voice recording introducing yourself (this is required; applications without audio will not be reviewed)

2. A short writing sample: a 4-5 sentence cold
 you would send a real estate agent to introduce a media company (this is required too)

3. Your cold calling and cold
 experience: what you sold, how many dials and
s per day, your results

4. Your internet speed and work setup

title: HIRING: Creative Scriptwriter & Content Brief Specialist
description:
**📩 TO APPLY: Contact us on 



# HIRING: Creative Scriptwriter & Content Brief Specialist (Remote)



We’re a fast-growing social media marketing agency looking for a highly creative, organized, and detail-oriented **Scriptwriter & Content Brief Specialist** to join our remote creative team.



This is not a basic copywriting or caption-writing position.



We’re looking for someone who understands social media content, video storytelling, and creative production. You should be able to take raw footage, client information, announcements, and creative ideas and turn them into clear, engaging scripts and detailed briefs that our video editors and graphic designers can execute.



Our team works across multiple client accounts, including publicly traded companies, restaurants, consumer brands, and other businesses.



We need someone who can think creatively, work independently, and consistently produce high-quality work without needing constant direction.



## What You'll Be Responsible For:



- Write engaging scripts for short-form videos, reels, advertisements, and promotional content.

- Create detailed post-production scripts using existing footage, interviews, and other video assets.

- Review raw footage and identify compelling moments, storytelling opportunities, and potential content ideas.

- Develop video structures that include hooks, storytelling, transitions, B-roll recommendations, on-screen text, and calls to action.

- Provide clear editing instructions so video editors understand exactly how each video should be produced.

- Create detailed creative briefs for graphic designers, including headlines, supporting copy, messaging, design direction, and visual references.

- Turn client announcements, press releases, events, and updates into engaging social media content.

- Research client industries, competitors, and relevant trends to develop creative content ideas.

- Understand and adapt to different client voices, industries, and audiences.

- Repurpose existing footage and content into additional video concepts and graphic opportunities.

- Work closely with video editors, graphic designers, strategists, and creative leadership.

- Revise scripts and briefs based on feedback while maintaining consistency and quality.

- Ensure scripts and briefs are accurate, complete, and ready for production before being assigned.

- Manage multiple creative assignments across different client accounts while meeting deadlines.



## What We're Looking For:



We are specifically looking for someone who is:



- **Creative** — you know how to make content interesting, engaging, and attention-grabbing.

- **A strong storyteller** — you understand how to structure videos that keep people watching.

- **Detail-oriented** — your scripts and briefs provide enough direction for the creative team to execute properly.

- **Proactive** — you identify content opportunities and suggest ideas without waiting to be told.

- **Extremely organized** — you can manage multiple scripts, briefs, and deadlines simultaneously.

- **A strong writer** — your written English is excellent, clear, and professional.

- **Research-driven** — you can learn about unfamiliar industries and turn complex information into understandable content.

- **Adaptable** — you can switch between different brands, industries, and creative styles.

- **Independent** — you do not need someone walking you through every assignment.

- **Solutions-focused** — you think through creative challenges instead of simply passing them to someone else.



We want someone who understands that great content starts with great creative direction.



## Requirements:



- Previous experience in video scripting, content writing, creative production, or a similar role.

- Strong understanding of social media platforms, especially Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and LinkedIn.

- Experience writing scripts for short-form video content.

- Ability to create detailed post-production scripts and editing instructions.

- Experience preparing creative briefs for graphic designers.

- Strong written and spoken English.

- Understanding of video editing concepts, pacing, storytelling, and visual composition.

- Ability to research and write about multiple industries.

- Experience working with a marketing agency, creative team, or production company strongly preferred.

- Comfortable managing multiple creative assignments simultaneously.

- Reliable computer and internet connection.

- Comfortable working consistent hours that overlap with a U.S.-based team.

- Experience with tools such as 
, Google Drive, 
, Figma, or similar platforms is a plus.

- Familiarity with AI writing and research tools is a plus, but the ability to think creatively and write independently is essential.



## This Role Is NOT For You If:



- You only know how to write captions or basic social media posts.

- You rely entirely on AI to generate your work without reviewing or improving it.

- You cannot understand how a video should flow from beginning to end.

- You struggle to turn raw footage into a compelling story.

- You write vague briefs that leave editors and designers confused.

- You need constant instructions for every creative assignment.

- You cannot adapt your writing style to different clients.

- You regularly miss deadlines or require constant reminders.

- You submit work without checking accuracy, spelling, or quality.

- You are uncomfortable receiving feedback and making revisions.



We are not looking for someone to simply write words.



**We are looking for someone who can turn ideas, footage, and information into production-ready creative content.**



## Schedule



**Full-time remote position.**



You must be comfortable working hours that overlap with our U.S.-based team.



Exact schedule will be discussed during the interview process.



## Compensation



Competitive monthly compensation based on experience.



There will also be opportunities for increased compensation and additional responsibility based on performance and growth within the company.

**Contact us on

1. A brief introduction about yourself and your relevant experience.

2. Examples of video scripts or content briefs you have created.

3. Any relevant portfolio or previous agency experience.

4. Your expected monthly compensation.

5. Your availability and preferred working hours.



**Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a practical creative assignment to demonstrate their scripting and briefing abilities.**

title: TikTok News Editor — Memes & B-Roll
description:
# TikTok News Editor — Memes & B-Roll



**PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING**



**Your FIRST message must include your COMPLETED editing assessment.**



Please do not message me just saying "I'm interested," "I want to apply," or sending only your resume.



The full job description, editing examples, raw footage, and assessment instructions are provided below.



**I am only reviewing applications that include the completed assessment.** You do not need to ask for permission or wait for an invitation to start.



## Who I'm Looking For



I'm looking for a creative short-form video editor who understands **American internet humor, TikTok/YouTube news commentary, memes, and how to find the EXACT clips that match what someone is talking about.**



I'm not looking for someone who only cuts pauses and adds captions.



I need someone who can listen to my commentary, understand the story, independently research the right footage, and make creative editing decisions.



For example, if I'm talking about an affiliate commission issue, I want the actual commission screen recording—not a random company logo.



If I'm discussing a creator's AI tool, I want that creator's original video—not generic AI footage.



**The ability to find the right visuals and understand comedic timing is the most important part of this job.**



## About the Job



I'm a TikTok Shop affiliate who has generated nearly $2 million in GMV over approximately the past year.



I'm building a daily series called **TikTok Shop Affiliate News**, covering three interesting stories about TikTok Shop, creators, affiliate commissions, products, platform updates, and AI tools.



My workflow is simple:



**I research and record → You handle the entire edit → I review and post.**



Your responsibilities include:



1. Editing my raw talking-head footage into complete episodes.

2. Independently finding original TikTok videos, articles, screenshots, screen recordings, and relevant memes.

3. Creating professional vertical split-screen videos with supporting footage on top and me talking on the bottom.

4. Adding well-timed humor, captions, headlines, zooms, and transitions.

5. Delivering polished, accurate videos without needing instructions for every individual clip.



This is an **ongoing paid position**, with at least one video per day and occasionally two or three.



Please include your expected rate per video or monthly rate and your availability.



## Required Editing Assessment



**FULL JOB DESCRIPTION + VISUAL EXAMPLES + ASSESSMENT INSTRUCTIONS:**







**You must open and read this PDF before applying.**



It contains the exact editing style I'm looking for, real screenshots, video references, and instructions for recreating my complete TikTok Shop news episode.



The assessment is unpaid and voluntary and is used only for hiring evaluation unless we separately agree otherwise.



You must recreate the **ENTIRE episode**, not a short sample. This includes the opening, all three stories, and the closing.



All raw footage and supporting materials are linked inside the PDF.



**Complete the assessment BEFORE sending your first message.**



## How to Apply



Your FIRST message must include:



1. **Completed assessment video** — a Google Drive link or another accessible video link.

2. **Your three best previous editing projects** — links to work you've personally edited.

3. **Your expected rate** — per finished video or monthly.

4. **Your availability** — working hours, time zone, and turnaround for one to three videos per day.

5. **Your editing software and relevant experience.**

6. **Your source links** — the main original clips and articles you used in the assessment.



Make sure your links can be opened without requesting access.



## Contact Me



**
:** hennyg1



**WhatsApp:** 
Contact me on ONE of these platforms and send your complete application in your first message.



**IMPORTANT: Messages that only say "I'm interested," "Can I apply?" or "Please send the assessment" will not be reviewed. Everything you need is already in the PDF.**



I'm looking forward to seeing what you can create!

title: Tax Accountant
description:
Tax Accountant – Private Family Office Wealth

Axis Consulting LLC

Position Type: Part-Time (Potential for Full-Time Conversion)

Industry: Private Family Office / Wealth & Asset Management

Location: 100% Remote – Philippines

Compensation: $9.00 USD per Hour + 10% Performance-Based Monthly Bonus



Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced, detail-oriented, and client-focused Part-Time Tax Accountant to support multiple private family offices serving high-net-worth (HNW) and ultra-high-net-worth (UHNW) individuals and families.

The ideal candidate will have experience in individual, trust, estate, partnership, and investment-related taxation, along with exceptional client-facing communication skills. This role involves direct client interaction, tax preparation and compliance, and coordination with external tax advisors and family office professionals.

This position offers the potential for full-time conversion based on individual performance, organizational needs, and position availability.



Primary Responsibilities

• Serve as a primary point of contact for clients, proactively requesting tax documentation (PBC lists), communicating via phone and
, and following up on outstanding items to ensure timely tax compliance and exceptional client service.

• Prepare and review federal and state tax returns for HNW individuals, trusts, estates, partnerships, LLCs, corporations, and other family-owned entities.

• Prepare quarterly estimated tax calculations, annual tax projections, and related payment schedules.

• Review financial statements, general ledgers, investment statements, Schedules K-1, Forms 1099, and other supporting tax documentation.

• Support tax planning related to investment income, capital gains, trusts, estates, wealth transfers, and family-owned entities.

• Research federal and state tax regulations and assist with tax notices, audits, and multistate reporting requirements.

• Coordinate with external CPAs, tax attorneys, wealth advisors, and family office accounting teams to facilitate tax preparation and compliance.

• Maintain organized tax records, track filing deadlines, and manage outstanding client requests and deliverables.

• Assist with tax-related reconciliations, year-end adjustments, and special projects as assigned.



Qualifications

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

• Minimum of 2 years of tax preparation, compliance, or accounting experience, preferably serving HNW individuals, trusts, partnerships, or privately held entities.

• Strong knowledge of U.S. federal and state individual, partnership, and fiduciary taxation, including Forms 1040, 1041, 1065, and 709.

• Exceptional client-facing communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to professionally engage HNW clients, clearly communicate documentation requirements, and proactively manage follow-ups.

• Familiarity with investment-related tax reporting, including capital gains, investment income, and Schedules K-1; Form 1065.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, data analysis, and reconciliations, and other tax preparation software.

• Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to independently manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

• High level of professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality when handling sensitive client financial information.



Preferred Qualifications

• Four (4) or more years of tax preparation, compliance, or accounting experience, preferably serving HNW individuals, trusts, partnerships, or privately held entities.

• Certified Public Accountant (CPA).

• Experience in a single-family office, multi-family office, private wealth management firm, or public accounting practice serving HNW/UHNW clients.

• Knowledge of estate and gift taxation, family investment partnerships, trusts, real estate, and alternative investments.

• Experience with CCH Axcess, ProSystem fx, UltraTax, or similar tax software.



Work Arrangement & Full-Time Conversion Opportunity

This is a 100% remote, part-time position based in the Philippines. Candidates must be available for scheduled meetings and client communications during designated U.S. business hours. Additional flexibility may be required during peak tax seasons and filing deadlines.

High-performing candidates who demonstrate strong technical expertise, exceptional client service, and consistent reliability will be considered for full-time conversion, subject to business needs and position availability.



Compensation

• Range Base Pay: $7.00 - $9.00 USD per hour depending on experience.

• Performance-Based Monthly Bonus: Eligible for a monthly bonus of up to 10% of base earnings, based on demonstrated performance, quality and accuracy of work, timely completion of assignments, client service, and achievement of established performance expectations. Bonus payments are subject to management review and discretionary approval.



About the Opportunity

This role provides the opportunity to support multiple high-net-worth families in a specialized private wealth environment, with exposure to investment structures, trusts, partnerships, and family-owned entities.

We are seeking a dependable tax professional who combines technical expertise with exceptional client service, professionalism, and discretion and is interested in a potential long-term opportunity with the firm.



About Axis Consulting LLC:

Axis Consulting LLC is a private boutique family-owned financial services firm dedicated to serving high-net-worth (HNW) and ultra-high-net-worth (UHNW) individuals, families, and privately held businesses. We specialize in providing personalized financial management, accounting, tax coordination, and family office support services tailored to the unique needs of our clients. With a focus on professionalism, discretion, and long-term relationships, our firm works closely with clients and their trusted advisors to help navigate complex financial matters, preserve generational wealth, and support their evolving financial goals. We pride ourselves on delivering attentive, high-quality service built on integrity, confidentiality, and a commitment to excellence through our professionals.



Please forward to us in a message a copy of your current resume for consideration. Also include one sentence why you should be considered for this role. Should your qualifications meet our needs for an interview, a member of our team will contact you directly. Thank you for your interest.

title: Product Sourcing Specialist
description:
Product Sourcing Specialist | China & Asia Manufacturing | Remote



Company: Rhino USA

Location: Philippines – Work From Home

Type: Full-Time | Long-Term Opportunity

Hours: 40 hours per week





Join a Growing International Consumer Products Brand



Rhino USA is a fast-growing American brand specialising in automotive, towing, off-road recovery, and outdoor adventure products.



Our products are sold through major retailers and online marketplaces, including Amazon, Walmart, and our own e-commerce channels.



We're expanding our New Product Development team and looking for an experienced Product Sourcing Specialist based in the Philippines to help us find great manufacturers, negotiate competitive pricing, and bring exciting new products to market.



This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working directly with Asian manufacturers, solving sourcing challenges, and taking ownership of projects from start to finish.



What You'll Be Doing



You'll work closely with our New Product Development team, taking responsibility for sourcing products and identifying reliable manufacturing partners.



Your main responsibilities include:



Supplier Sourcing: Research, identify, and evaluate manufacturers, primarily in China and Southeast Asia.



RFQs & Negotiations: Request quotations, compare suppliers, negotiate pricing, MOQs, lead times, and commercial terms.



Supplier Evaluation: Assess manufacturing capabilities, product quality, reliability, and suitability for our business.



Product Sampling: Coordinate product samples, communicate specifications, and follow up on sample development and approvals.



Packaging Coordination: Work with suppliers and internal teams to coordinate packaging requirements and approvals.



Project Management: Keep sourcing projects moving forward, following up with suppliers and ensuring deadlines are met.



Reporting: Maintain organised sourcing records, supplier comparisons, and project updates using 
 and other internal systems.



You'll collaborate with our Quality, Compliance, and Production teams, but your primary focus will be finding the right manufacturing partners and securing competitive sourcing solutions.



What We're Looking For



We're looking for someone with real sourcing experience who knows how to communicate with factories, compare quotations, and manage multiple sourcing projects independently.



Must Have:



3+ years of hands-on product sourcing, procurement, or supplier management experience.



Experience sourcing directly from manufacturers in China.



Strong understanding of RFQs, pricing negotiations, MOQs, lead times, and supplier evaluation.



Experience using supplier sourcing platforms such as Alibaba, Made-in-China, Global Sources, or similar.



Excellent written and spoken English.



Strong organisation, follow-up, and attention to detail.



Comfortable using Excel or Google Sheets to compare suppliers and manage sourcing data.



Nice to Have:



Experience sourcing from Vietnam, Thailand, or Cambodia.



Experience with automotive accessories, hardware, tools, outdoor products, or other manufactured consumer goods.



Knowledge of international trade terms (FOB, EXW, Incoterms).



Familiarity with 
, ERP systems, or sourcing project management tools.



Experience coordinating product samples, custom manufacturing, and packaging.



Experience using AI tools to improve research and productivity.



You don't need experience with every system we use. We're more interested in your actual sourcing ability, initiative, and supplier management experience.



Why Join Rhino USA?



Stable, Long-Term Opportunity: Join an established international business with a growing product range.



Work From Home: Fully remote position based in the Philippines.



Real Responsibility: Manage your own sourcing projects and make meaningful contributions to new product launches.



International Exposure: Work with manufacturers across Asia and collaborate with an experienced global team.



Career Development: Opportunity to grow your responsibilities as our sourcing and product development operations expand.



Working Hours



40 hours per week, Monday to Friday.



We prefer candidates who can work during Asian business hours to communicate effectively with manufacturers in China and Southeast Asia, with some flexibility for meetings with our international team.



How to Apply



Please send your resume along with short answers to the following three questions:



How many years of product sourcing experience do you have, and which countries have you sourced from?



Give us an example of a product you sourced directly from a manufacturer, including how you found the supplier and negotiated the quotation.



What sourcing platforms or methods do you use to find and evaluate new manufacturers?



Please also include your expected hourly rate in USD.



We're looking for someone who can take ownership, communicate confidently with suppliers, and become a valuable long-term member of the Rhino USA team.



We look forward to hearing from you!

title: BHA billing Specialist
description:
Safe Counseling PSC is  (BHA) seeking an experienced Behavioral Health Facility Billing Specialist to manage insurance claims, billing, reimbursement, and revenue cycle operations.



We are specifically looking for someone with direct experience billing for licensed behavioral health agencies, mental health facilities, or community behavioral health organizations.



This is NOT a traditional private practice or group practice billing position. Candidates must understand the differences between billing under an individual or group provider and billing under a licensed behavioral health agency/facility.



Key Responsibilities



Prepare, submit, and track facility/agency-level behavioral health insurance claims.



Submit Medicaid claims and commercial insurance through Washington ProviderOne and Availity or applicable MCO payer portals



Understand the appropriate use of CMS-1500 (837P) versus UB-04 (837I) claims based on payer contracts and covered services.



Verify correct use of agency Type 2 NPI, taxonomy, billing provider, rendering provider, service facility, and payer-specific billing requirements.



Submit claims for mental health assessments, individual therapy, behavioral health support, peer support, and other authorized outpatient behavioral health services.



Understand billing requirements for intensive outpatient programs (IOP) and other facility based behavioral health services.



Identify and correct rejected or denied claims, including provider enrollment, taxonomy, authorization, coding, and credentialing-related errors.



Verify Medicaid eligibility, managed care enrollment, authorization requirements, and payer reimbursement rules.



Review remittance advice, reconcile payments, and follow up on unpaid claims.



Maintain accurate billing records and ensure compliance with Washington HCA, Medicaid, and payer policies.



Coordinate with agency leadership and credentialing specialists to resolve billing and contracting issues.



Required Qualifications



Minimum 2 years of hands-on billing experience with licensed behavioral health agencies, community mental health agencies, or comparable behavioral health facilities.



Direct experience submitting claims under an organizational/facility NPI.



Working knowledge of Washington State Medicaid (Apple Health), ProviderOne, and Medicaid managed care plans.



Experience with behavioral health HCPCS and CPT codes, including H-codes.



Understanding of BHA enrollment, payer contracting, agency billing, and reimbursement requirements.



Experience resolving facility-related claim denials and rejections.



Familiarity with Availity, ProviderOne, and electronic health record billing systems.



Strong understanding of HIPAA, billing compliance, and documentation requirements.



Preferred Qualifications



Previous billing experience with a  DOH-licensed Behavioral Health Agency.



Experience with mental health intensive outpatient programs (IOP).



Experience billing Medicaid MCOs, including Coordinated Care, Molina, CHPW, UnitedHealthcare Community Plan, and Wellpoint, where applicable.



Familiarity with SimplePractice.



Experience assisting newly licensed BHAs with establishing billing workflows and resolving payer enrollment issues.



Important: Facility Billing Experience Required

- Coordinate with supply chain, inventory, and operations teams to support product availability and promotional planning.

- Identify opportunities to improve marketplace performance and expand the company's online sales channels.

- Monitor advertising budgets, campaign performance, return on ad spend (ROAS), customer acquisition cost (CAC), and conversion rates.

- Oversee audience targeting, retargeting, campaign testing, and performance optimization.

- Use analytics and reporting tools to identify trends, evaluate campaign effectiveness, and recommend improvements.



 4. Social Media & Content Marketing

- Oversee social media strategy, content planning, publishing schedules, and audience engagement across relevant platforms.

- Coordinate content calendars, campaign assets, product announcements, and promotional activities.

- Monitor social media performance, audience growth, engagement rates, and referral traffic.

- Ensure social media initiatives support the broader marketing and e-commerce strategies.



5. Influencer & Partnership Marketing

- Establish campaign objectives, deliverables, budgets, and performance indicators.

6. Shopify & Website Marketing

- Monitor website traffic, conversion rates, customer behavior, and sales performance.

- Coordinate website content updates, landing pages, promotional banners, product merchandising, and conversion optimization.

- Identify opportunities to improve the customer journey, user experience, and online store performance.

- Collaborate with relevant teams on SEO,
 marketing, and customer retention initiatives, as applicable.



7. Events & Brand Activations

- Plan, coordinate, and oversee marketing events, trade shows, industry exhibitions, product showcases, and brand activations.

- Manage event objectives, budgets, timelines, logistics, promotional materials, and team assignments.

- Coordinate with internal departments, event organizers, vendors, influencers, and external partners.

- Ensure events support brand awareness, lead generation, partnerships, customer engagement, and sales opportunities.

- Evaluate event performance and prepare post-event reports with recommendations for future activities.



 8. Performance Monitoring & Reporting

- Establish and monitor KPIs for the marketing department and its individual functions.

- Consolidate reports covering marketplace sales, advertising performance, website conversions, social media engagement, influencer campaigns, and event results.

- Analyze marketing data to identify opportunities, challenges, and areas for improvement.

- Present regular performance updates, insights, and recommendations to executive leadership.

- Ensure marketing activities are evaluated based on measurable business outcomes, not just completed tasks.

- Recommend adjustments to strategies, budgets, and resource allocation based on performance data.



9. Cross-Functional Coordination

- Work closely with Sales, Supply Chain, Finance, Product, and executive leadership to align marketing activities with company goals.

- Coordinate promotional calendars, product launches, inventory availability, campaign requirements, and budget approvals.

- Ensure clear communication, accountability, and timely execution across marketing functions.

- Identify operational gaps and implement improvements to departmental processes and collaboration.



Qualifications & Requirements



- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field preferred.

- At least 5 years of relevant marketing experience, including experience managing marketing campaigns and leading people or teams.

- Proven experience overseeing multiple marketing functions, preferably in e-commerce, retail, consumer products, or a similar business environment.

- Experience with eBay and Walmart marketplace operations or marketplace account management.

- Strong understanding of digital marketing, paid advertising, Meta Ads, social media management, influencer marketing, and content strategy.

- Working knowledge of Shopify and e-commerce website performance optimization.

- Experience planning and managing marketing events, partnerships, or brand activations.

- Proficiency in marketing analytics, KPI tracking, budget management, and performance reporting.

- Strong leadership, project management, communication, and decision-making skills.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities, lead remote teams, and ensure accountability across different marketing functions.

- Data-driven mindset with a strong focus on business results, continuous improvement, and return on investment.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)



Performance will be evaluated based on agreed targets, including:



- Marketing-attributed revenue growth and contribution to overall sales.

- E-commerce marketplace sales, conversion rates, and account performance.

- Paid advertising efficiency, ROAS, and customer acquisition cost.

- Website traffic, conversion rates, and Shopify store performance.

- Social media growth, engagement, and referral traffic.

- Influencer campaign performance and measurable business outcomes.

- Event execution, budget adherence, and lead or partnership generation.

- Achievement of marketing campaign deadlines, budgets, and objectives.

- Team productivity, quality of deliverables, and achievement of individual KPIs.

- Accuracy and timeliness of reporting and cross-department coordination.



Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is a strategic marketing leader who understands how different marketing functions work together to drive business growth. They can guide specialists, establish clear priorities, manage budgets, interpret performance data, and take ownership of the department's overall results.



This person should be comfortable managing both the strategic direction and operational execution of marketing activities while building a collaborative, accountable, and results-oriented team.

Amino 365 is looking for motivated, outgoing, and creative individuals to find new customers and generate sales through cold outreach.



This is a remote, performance-based sales opportunity. You can manage your own schedule, but you must be willing to consistently contact new people, create content, participate in online communities, and follow up with potential customers.



## PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING



This position provides:



- **Weekly base payment: $1**

- **Sales commission: 15% of eligible sales**

- **Commission limit: No predetermined cap**

- **Hourly pay: None**

- **Guaranteed commission income: None**

- **Warm leads provided: None**



The majority of your earnings will come from the sales you personally generate.



Amino 365 does not guarantee customers, leads, sales, commissions, or a minimum level of income. If you want a traditional fixed salary or hourly position, this opportunity will not be the right fit.



## WHAT ARE PEPTIDES?



Peptides are short chains of amino 
. Amino 
 are the small building blocks that make up proteins.



Different peptide compounds are studied across many areas, including metabolic science, performance science, tissue and recovery research, cellular and longevity science, skincare science, neuroscience, and other specialized fields.



Amino 365 offers a broad selection of peptide compounds and related products through its online store.



You do not need to be a scientist. However, you must be willing to learn the basic product categories, review the information provided by Amino 365, and clearly explain the company and its product selection to potential customers.



## THIS IS A COLD-OUTREACH POSITION



Amino 365 does not provide a list of customers waiting to purchase.



You are responsible for finding potential customers, starting conversations, introducing them to Amino 365, and following up until they purchase.



Cold outreach means contacting or engaging with people who have not previously spoken with you or Amino 365. You must be proactive and comfortable creating your own sales opportunities.



Your outreach may include:



- Commenting on relevant TikTok videos

- Creating and publishing TikTok posts or videos

- Commenting on relevant Instagram posts and Reels

- Creating Instagram posts, Stories, and Reels

- Sending personalized Instagram and TikTok direct messages

- Participating in relevant Reddit communities

- Creating helpful Reddit posts and comments

- Responding to people already discussing peptides or related subjects

- Participating in relevant
 groups

- Joining relevant 
 servers and online communities

- Contacting fitness, wellness, beauty, and peptide content creators

- Connecting with personal trainers, coaches, and community leaders

- Reaching out through
 and other social platforms

- Using your personal network to generate introductions

- Testing new outreach ideas and determining what produces sales



Representatives should be creative. You should not wait for someone to give you a daily list of people to contact.



Look for relevant conversations, pages, creators, videos, posts, and communities where potential customers are already active. Find natural opportunities to start conversations and introduce Amino 365.



Outreach should be relevant, personalized, and professional. Simply sending the same random message to thousands of unrelated people is unlikely to produce strong results.



## BEST CUSTOMER MARKETS



The strongest potential customers are generally people who are already familiar with peptides or interested in learning more about peptide products.



Potential markets include:



- Existing peptide customers

- Peptide education and information communities

- Fitness and bodybuilding communities

- Athletic performance communities

- Weight-management and metabolic-health communities

- Biohacking and longevity communities

- Recovery, mobility, and wellness communities

- Skincare, beauty, and cosmetic-science communities

- Scientific and biotechnology communities

- Personal trainers and fitness coaches

- Wellness professionals and community leaders

- Content creators with relevant audiences



You do not need to target every market. Choose one or two markets you understand and focus on building a trusted network within those communities.



## HOW YOU GET PAID



You earn a **15% commission on eligible sales** attributed to your personal affiliate code or referral link.



Our average customer order is approximately **$250**:



**$250 Average Order × 15% Commission = $37.50 Commission**



Your $1 weekly base payment is added to the commission you earn.



Example weekly earnings:



- 1 average sale = $250 in sales | $37.50 commission | **$38.50 total**

- 2 average sales = $500 in sales | $75 commission | **$76 total**

- 4 average sales = $1,000 in sales | $150 commission | **$151 total**

Order amounts will vary. These examples are for illustration only and do not represent guaranteed earnings.



There is no predetermined limit on the commission you can earn. The more eligible sales you generate, the more you can earn.



## HOW THE AFFILIATE SYSTEM WORKS



Every representative receives:



- **Personal Affiliate Code:** Customers can enter your code at checkout so eligible sales are credited to you.



- **Personal Referral Link:** You receive a unique website link that tracks customers referred by you.



- **Personal Sales Dashboard:** You can monitor attributed sales, commissions, and overall performance.



- **Sales and Marketing Materials:** Amino 365 provides product information, promotional materials, outreach examples, and other resources.

## WHAT YOU WILL DO



Your responsibilities include:

This is not a passive affiliate role. Simply posting your code once and waiting for sales is unlikely to be successful. Strong representatives consistently start conversations, follow up, create content, and test new ways to reach potential customers.



## WHO SHOULD APPLY?



This opportunity may be a good fit if you:



- Are comfortable contacting people you do not already know

title: Amazon Online Arbitrage Sourcing VA
description:
Position: Amazon FBA Online Arbitrage Product Sourcing VA (Commission Only)

Pay: $6 per lead I purchase + 5% profit share on every sold unit from your leads

Schedule: Flexible. Work your own hours. Paid on results, not time.



EXPERIENCE REQUIRED. AVAILABLE TO START IMMEDIATELY.



Do NOT apply if you have never sourced profitable products for Amazon FBA before. I need someone who already understands Amazon product sourcing and can work independently from day one.



You should already know how to analyze Amazon listings, research suppliers, verify websites, check sellers and competition, calculate profit, and d
 whether a product is actually worth buying.



HOW YOU GET PAID 💰



There is no salary or hourly pay. Everything is commission based.



$6 per purchased lead: You earn $6 for every lead I actually buy inventory from. Submitting a lead does not earn the $6. It’s paid once I place an order from that lead.



5% profit share: You also get 5% of the net profit on units from your leads that sell. Net profit means sale price minus Amazon fees, product cost, shipping, prep, and any other direct costs. [Applies to the first purchase only / Applies to all reorders for X months.]



Payment schedule: All payments are made weekly. Each week you’re paid $6 for every lead I bought from that week, plus 5% of the net profit on any of your units that sold that week.



The more strong leads you find, the more you earn. There’s no cap.



TRIAL PERIOD



Before you’re hired, you’ll complete a short trial so I can see your sourcing skills firsthand.



You’ll get my sourcing spreadsheet, my ungated brand list, and the example competition chart

You’ll have [5] days to submit 3 to 5 leads that meet ALL the requirements below

I’ll review each lead the same way I review regular submissions

If I buy from any of your trial leads, you get paid the normal $6 per lead

If your leads consistently pass, you’re hired and move to the regular team



Trial leads should show your best work. Accuracy, source verification, and good judgment on quantity matter more than speed.



WEEKLY TARGET



Aim for at least 25 quality leads per week. VAs who consistently send leads I buy from will get priority on brand lists and first access to any future paid or higher-commission roles.



Quality matters more than volume. I’d rather get 5 strong leads than 20 bad ones. Leads that clearly break the requirements earn nothing, and repeatedly sending them will get you removed from the team.



PRODUCT REQUIREMENTS



Every product you submit must:



Be from a brand I’m already approved/ungated to sell

Make at least $2 profit per unit

Have at least 100 estimated sales per month

NOT be a generic brand

Have realistic competition where I can actually get sales (I’ll give you an example chart for the criteria)

Leave enough room for me to join the listing without crashing the price

Come from a REAL, TRUSTWORTHY SOURCE

Be in stock and available to buy

Match the EXACT Amazon product/variation

Include the correct source link

Include the correct Amazon ASIN/listing

Not have already been submitted by another VA on my team



ROI is NOT my main requirement. I care more about actual dollar profit, sales volume, competition, and whether I can realistically sell the inventory.



QUANTITY MATTERS



Don’t submit deals that only work when buying an unrealistic quantity.



Example: if a product only meets my requirements at 25 units, but the listing sells around 50 units a month and has 20 competing sellers, I’m not buying 25 units.



Look at monthly sales, number of sellers, competition, and minimum purchase quantity together. The deal has to make sense for my business, not just look good on a spreadsheet.



SOURCE VERIFICATION IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT



You MUST verify every website before you submit it.



A VA recently sent me a fake website that looked like a major retailer. I bought from it and my card information was stolen. That can’t happen again.



Do NOT submit:



Fake retailer websites

Scam websites

Copycat websites

Suspicious Shopify stores

Random websites with no established reputation

Sources you haven’t properly researched

A retailer/distributor different from the one you listed in the spreadsheet



If you’re unsure whether a source is legit, DON’T SUBMIT IT. Ask me first.



YOU SHOULD ALREADY KNOW



Amazon Seller Central

Amazon FBA

Online Arbitrage

Product sourcing

Keepa

Stealth Seller (required, this is what we use) or SellerAmp SAS

Buy Box analysis

Sales rank / estimated monthly sales

Amazon fees

Profit calculations

Seller/competition analysis

Variation matching

Source verification

Checking whether Amazon is on the listing

Spotting dangerous price drops or listings with too much competition

Amazon seller storefront sourcing / storefront stalking



You should NOT need me to teach you the basics of Amazon sourcing.



HOW TO APPLY



Do NOT send a generic copy-and-paste application.



Start your application with:



“I HAVE AMAZON SOURCING EXPERIENCE”



Then answer these questions:



How long have you been sourcing products for Amazon?

Have you done Online Arbitrage before?

What sourcing tools have you used?

Do you know how to use Keepa? Explain what you normally check on a Keepa chart.

Do you know how to use Stealth Seller? If not, have you used SellerAmp?

How do you d
 whether a listing has too many sellers?

How do you verify that a sourcing website is legitimate?

How do you d
 how many units of a product to recommend buying?

What’s the difference between profit and ROI?

Have you used Amazon seller storefronts to find more profitable products? Explain your process.

Are you comfortable with commission-only pay and a trial period? How soon can you start?



Send an example of an Amazon sourcing spreadsheet you’ve worked with before, with confidential client info removed.



FINAL TEST: Include one example ASIN + source link you think is worth researching for Online Arbitrage, and briefly explain why you picked it.



If you can’t answer these questions, please don’t apply.



I’m looking for someone who already knows what they’re doing, pays attention to detail, follows instructions, verifies sources, and can consistently find products I can actually buy and sell.

About the Role

Are you a detail-oriented professional who enjoys both numbers and keeping things organized? We’re looking for a Remote Accounting & Office Assistant to support a growing HOA management company with accounts payable, homeowner payments, records management, and resale processing. You’ll work in CINC and AvidXchange and play a key part in keeping association finances and records accurate as the company continues to grow. If you enjoy variety, take pride in accuracy, and want a role with real room to grow, this could be the right fit for you.



Key Responsibilities



Accounting



Process accounts payable in AvidXchange, including uploading invoices daily

Process maintenance invoices and close out completed work orders

Handle online and lockbox payments

Record legal collection payments and upload them to homeowner accounts

Manage bank returns and returned check communications

Process water billing charges and leasing fees

Prepare homeowner statements

Reconcile vendor auto payments

Add tax information to CINC



Office and Records Support



Maintain and organize digital association files and records

Process scanned mail: upload, file, and distribute invoices and communications to the right team members

Process returned mail

Assist with processing new sales and resales

Handle Secretary of State registrations and follow-ups

Track certified letters as needed

Assist rental companies with ledgers, lease uploads, and violation research

Cover for other assistants when they are out

Support special projects as needed



Qualifications



Experience in HOA or property management accounting or administration for a US-based company

Hands-on CINC experience is highly preferred

AvidXchange experience is a plus

Working knowledge of AP, payment processing, and reconciliations

Strong organization skills and attention to detail

Proficient in Excel

Clear, professional written and verbal English

Able to manage multiple tasks, meet deadlines, and work independently

Available during US business hours



Why Join Us



Fully remote role

Long-term position with room for growth

Hands-on experience in HOA accounting and operations

A supportive team environment



How to Apply



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph and start your message with the phrase “You can count on me” so we know you read the full post. Applications without this phrase will not be entertained.



Your application should include:



1. Résumé (PDF)

Attach your résumé listing your accounting or administrative roles, the US-based HOA or property management companies you supported, and the software you used (especially CINC and AvidXchange).



2. Video introduction (2–3 minutes)

Record a short video and include the link in your message (Loom, Google Drive, or YouTube unlisted). Make sure anyone with the link can view it. In the video, cover:



Who you are and your current or most recent role

Your experience with AP, payment processing, and records management for US clients

How you keep your work accurate when juggling accounting and admin tasks

Why this role interests you



Please speak naturally and don’t read from a script. We want to hear how you communicate.



3. Written answers to these questions



How many years have you worked in HOA or property management accounting or administration for a US-based company?

Which accounting tasks have you done in CINC? Have you used AvidXchange?

How do you handle a returned check or bank return, from posting to homeowner communication?

Have you processed resales or worked with rental company ledger requests? Briefly describe your role.

Confirm your availability for US business hours and your earliest start date.



Incomplete applications, including those missing the résumé, video link, or written answers, will not be considered.

title: Product Associate
description:
Tree To Tub is looking for a Product Associate who can help us move product development work forward quickly, accurately, and consistently.



You'll support the development of new personal care products by researching potential manufacturers and suppliers, coordinating product requirements and documentation, and keeping development projects on track. You'll work closely with our Product Director and coordinate with different teams and external partners.



We're looking for someone who is resourceful, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking initiative. You should be able to research independently, organize information, manage multiple follow-ups, and make sure things don't fall through the cracks.



What you'll be doing:



Initial responsibilities:

• Research potential manufacturers, suppliers, and product-related requirements.

• Gather and organize supplier information, quotations, samples, and comparisons.

• Coordinate supplier communication and follow-ups.

• Maintain accurate supplier records, project trackers, and documentation.

• Identify delays, missing information, and potential issues early.

• Help improve and document recurring processes.



Expanded responsibilities:

• Following an initial assessment and training period, we intend to expand the role to include:

• Assisting with product documentation, ingredient checks, compliance requirements, and testing coordination.

• Tracking product development timelines, milestones, and outstanding requirements.

• Coordinating with internal teams and external partners to keep product development projects moving.



What we're looking for:

• Strong organization and attention to detail.

• Ability to work quickly without compromising accuracy.

• Good research skills and the ability to assess and organize information independently.

• Strong follow-through and responsiveness.

• Ability to manage multiple tasks, timelines, and people.

• Clear written communication.

• Experience in operations, procurement, supply chain, logistics, research, or project coordination is an advantage, but not required.

• Experience sourcing manufacturers or suppliers is a plus.



Where this role can take you:

• This role gives you the opportunity to build experience across the product development process, from supplier research and sourcing to compliance coordination and product launches. 

• As you become more familiar with our products and processes, you'll have the opportunity to take on more responsibility in managing product development projects and coordinating launches from start to finish.

• Your ability to execute, research, stay organized, and learn will help you grow into these responsibilities.



Why join Tree To Tub?

• Fully remote work with a flexible schedule.

• 35-hour workweek.

• 24 combined vacation and sick leave days.

• Healthcare coverage.

• Performance-based year-end bonus.

• Opportunities to learn and grow.

• Annual company retreat.



Interested?

If you're someone who enjoys making things happen, finding information, keeping work organized, and following through on commitments, we'd like to hear from you.
