title: Legal Bookkeeper and Accountant (Trust Accounting, QuickBooks, Clio)
description:
We only review applications from candidates who meet all of the required qualifications listed below.



HOW TO APPLY



Send your application to 
 with the subject line “Bookkeeper Application - [Your Name]” and include:



1. Resume highlighting your bookkeeping and accounting experience, especially with law firms

2. Cover letter describing your relevant experience as it relates to this role

3. A short summary of your experience with trust accounting and three-way reconciliation, including the firms or clients you handled and the tools you used

4. If applicable, a short summary of your payroll experience, including the platforms you used and the types of workers you paid (US employees, US contractors, offshore contractors)

5. Expected monthly salary in USD

6. Available start date



POSITION OVERVIEW



We are seeking a Bookkeeper and Accountant to manage the books for Bay Legal, PC, a full-service California law firm. You will keep our operating and trust accounts accurate, reconciled, and compliant, and work closely with management on financial reporting. Experience with law firm accounting is required. You need to understand how a law firm handles client funds, how trust accounting works, and how billing flows from Clio into the books. Experience running US payroll and managing employee benefits is a strong plus.



Schedule: Full-time, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Pacific Time (California), Monday to Friday



RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Maintain accurate books in QuickBooks, including categorizing transactions and managing accounts payable and receivable

2. Complete monthly bank and credit card reconciliations for all operating accounts

3. Manage trust (IOLTA) accounting and complete monthly three-way reconciliations

4. Make sure client funds are handled correctly, including retainers, trust transfers, and disbursements

5. Work with Clio billing and keep Clio and QuickBooks records in sync

6. Prepare monthly financial reports and flag discrepancies or issues to management

7. Support payroll processing and benefits administration (if experienced)



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



1. 3 or more years of bookkeeping and accounting experience

2. Proven experience doing bookkeeping and accounting for law firms

3. Strong knowledge of trust accounting and three-way reconciliation

4. Strong knowledge of US accounting and bookkeeping practices

5. Expert-level proficiency in QuickBooks

6. Working knowledge of Clio, including Clio billing and trust accounting features

7. Solid understanding of how a law firm operates, including client funds, retainers, and billing

8. Strong attention to detail and the ability to keep records accurate and audit-ready

9. Excellent written and spoken English

10. Available to work 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Pacific Time (California), Monday to Friday

11. Reliable remote setup and stable internet connection



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



1. Experience running payroll through Gusto

2. Experience managing payroll for a mix of US employees, US contractors, and offshore contractors

3. Knowledge of US employee benefits, including 401(k) plans and medical insurance (such as Humana)

4. Experience with other US insurance and benefits administration

5. Familiarity with US payroll compliance, including tax filings and contractor documentation (W-2, 1099)



COMPENSATION & BENEFITS PACKAGE



Monthly Salary

US Paid Holidays

Paid Time Off: 10 days annually

title: Outreach & Partnerships Specialist (B2B Follow-Up + Creator Partnerships)
description:
About us

We're a small, founder-led e-commerce studio running two US-focused DTC brands:

A personalized book brand. Our newest product is a B2B gifting program: companies send their prospects a real, printed book written about that person, then follow up once it lands. It's the most memorable first touch a prospect will ever get.

A health tech brand making simple health smartwatches for adults 65+ and the families who look out for them.

Lean team, real ownership, fast decisions. You'll report to our marketing and operations lead and work directly with the founder.

The role

About 80% of your time covers three areas. The other 20% goes to whatever marketing work matters most that week: research, launch support, and testing new channels.

1. B2B follow-up (top priority)

We mail personalized books to targeted decision makers at US companies, mostly marketing, sales, and HR leaders.

Once a book is delivered, you call,
, and message the recipient on LinkedIn to turn their surprise into a booked demo.

You research prospects before reaching out and log every touch.

As you ramp up, you'll run some intro calls yourself.

If we test B2B for the smartwatch brand, you'll also reach out to organizations that serve older adults.

2. Creator partnerships

Find and vet creators on TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube:

Parenting and family creators for the book brand

Aging, caregiving, and retirement creators (including "adult children of aging parents") for the smartwatch brand

Pitch collaborations, agree on deliverables, coordinate product seeding, keep content on schedule, and keep good relationships warm.

3.
 marketing

Help write, build, and send campaigns and simple automated flows (we use Klaviyo).

What success looks like

Every delivered book is followed up within a day.

Demos are booked every week.

A steady stream of creator content goes live.

The pipeline is clean enough that anyone can see where every lead stands.

We'll set specific targets together in your first month.

What you bring

2+ years in B2B outbound (SDR/BDR), partnerships, or influencer marketing

Real experience cold calling US businesses (outbound, not only inbound support)

Excellent spoken English: natural and confident with senior US professionals

Strong written English for
s, LinkedIn messages, and DMs

Persistence across multiple touches, and resilience with "no"

Experience vetting creators, including spotting fake followers and weak engagement

Discipline with a CRM or tracker (we use Airtable)

Comfort with priorities that shift week to week

Bonus points

Apollo, Klaviyo, or similar tools

Experience selling to marketing, sales, or HR leaders

Familiarity with corporate gifting or direct mail outreach

Details

Long-term contract, about 40 hours per week

Remote

You must work US Pacific business hours, because calls happen when US prospects are at their desks. That means a fixed shift of 12 am to 8 am Manila time.

title: Customer Service & Order Coordination Specialist

, spreadsheets, messaging apps and online systems.

How to apply

title: HR & Payroll Administrator
description:

Responsibilities include processing payroll accurately and on time, maintaining employee records, onboarding and offboarding employees, tracking vacation/sick time, assisting with benefits administration, preparing payroll and HR reports, handling employee documentation, maintaining personnel files, and helping ensure compliance with company policies and applicable employment requirements.



The ideal candidate is organized, dependable, detail-oriented, and comfortable handling confidential employee and payroll information. Experience with payroll software, Microsoft Excel, and general HR administration is required. Qualifications: Previous payroll and HR administrative experience; strong attention to detail; excellent organizational and communication skills; ability to maintain confidentiality; proficiency with Excel and payroll/accounting software; and knowledge of California payroll and employment practices strongly preferred.

title: Client Intake & Outreach Specialist - Mortgage Sales

Mortgage Brain AI | Remote, Philippines | Full-Time



Schedule: Full-time, flexible hours with required overlap during Canadian Eastern Time business hours



Compensation: $500–$800/month, depending on experience, plus performance-based bonuses



About Mortgage Brain AI



Mortgage Brain AI is a Canadian company helping Ontario homeowners explore mortgage and home-equity options, including refinancing and debt consolidation.



We combine technology with personalized support to help clients better understand their options and take the next step with confidence.



We're looking for a reliable, organized, and confident communicator to join our growing team. If you enjoy speaking with people, staying organized, and following through on tasks, this could be a great long-term opportunity.

Your job is to make that first connection, ask straightforward questions, gather basic information, and help qualified inquiries move to the next stage of our intake process.



You'll work closely with our Canadian client relations team to ensure they receive accurate information and can focus their time on clients who are ready for a more detailed conversation.

, and SMS.

- Excellent spoken and written English, with clear, professional telephone communication.

- Confidence making outbound calls and speaking with prospective clients.

- Strong listening skills and the ability to ask questions naturally.

- Excellent organization, attention to detail, and follow-through.

- Experience using CRM platforms and maintaining accurate client records.

- Comfortable working with
, calendars, spreadsheets, and digital communication tools.

- Ability to follow established scripts and processes while maintaining natural, personable conversations.

- A proactive, dependable attitude and willingness to learn.

- Reliable internet, a quiet workspace, and a suitable computer setup.

- Availability to work a consistent full-time schedule with some overlap during Canadian business hours.



*Nice to Have*

title: Business Development & Sales Professionals | Staffing & Recruitment Industry
description:
Business Development & Sales Professionals | Staffing & Recruitment Industry

Full-time · Fully Remote · Based in the Philippines · Potential Direct Hire Opportunities with US Staffing & Recruitment Firms



IMPORTANT: Direct business development or sales experience within the staffing and recruitment industry is mandatory. Applicants whose sales experience is exclusively outside the staffing and recruitment industry will not be considered.



COMPLETE YOUR PROFILE HERE: 



About the Opportunity

Alderstone Partners is expanding its network of experienced Business Development and Sales Professionals based in the Philippines for potential direct hire opportunities with staffing agencies, recruitment firms, and executive search organizations serving the US market.



We are connecting with professionals who have demonstrated experience developing new business, acquiring clients, and building commercial relationships specifically within the staffing and recruitment industry.



This posting is part of our ongoing talent network development and is not tied to a single confirmed vacancy. Our goal is to identify and assess qualified professionals whose experience may align with the future hiring requirements of our partner firms.

Opportunities may include Business Development Representatives, Business Development Managers, Account Executives, Client Acquisition Specialists, Staffing Sales Professionals, and other related commercial roles.



We are particularly interested in professionals who understand how staffing and recruitment firms generate revenue, secure new client accounts, develop hiring relationships, and convert business opportunities into active recruitment engagements.



What You May Be Responsible For

Responsibilities will vary depending on the hiring organization, role, and commercial objectives.

* Identify and research prospective clients that may require staffing, recruitment, executive search, or talent acquisition services.

* Develop new business opportunities through targeted prospecting, cold calling,
 outreach, LinkedIn, referrals, and professional networking.

* Engage hiring managers, talent acquisition leaders, HR executives, business owners, and other decision makers to understand their hiring needs.

* Introduce staffing and recruitment services, communicate their value, and position relevant solutions based on client requirements.

* Qualify prospects by evaluating hiring demand, recruitment challenges, decision making authority, timelines, and potential commercial value.

* Schedule discovery calls, client meetings, and introductory conversations with qualified prospective clients.

* Build and maintain a consistent sales pipeline, progressing opportunities from initial outreach through qualification, proposal, negotiation, and client acquisition.

* Support discussions involving recruitment service agreements, placement fees, staffing arrangements, and commercial terms where applicable.

* Develop relationships with existing clients to identify additional hiring requirements, repeat business, and account expansion opportunities.

* Collaborate with recruitment and delivery teams to align client expectations, hiring requirements, and recruitment capabilities.

* Maintain accurate prospect records, sales activities, client communications, and opportunity updates using CRM platforms.

* Track business development performance through relevant measures such as qualified meetings, sales opportunities, new accounts, job orders, and revenue generation.



What We Are Looking For

* Direct professional experience in business development, sales, client acquisition, or account development specifically within staffing and recruitment organizations.

* Demonstrated experience selling staffing, permanent placement, recruitment process outsourcing, executive search, or related recruitment services.

* Experience prospecting and engaging US companies, hiring managers, HR leaders, talent acquisition teams, or business decision-makers.

* Practical understanding of the staffing and recruitment business model, including client acquisition, job order generation, placement fees, and recruitment delivery.

* Experience conducting outbound sales activities, including cold calling,
 prospecting, LinkedIn outreach, and relationship development.

* Ability to identify qualified business opportunities, conduct discovery conversations, and communicate recruitment service offerings effectively.

* Familiarity with staffing sales cycles, client objections, commercial negotiations, and relationship management.

* Experience using CRM platforms, prospecting databases, lead generation tools, and sales engagement systems.

* Strong written and spoken English, with confidence communicating directly with US business stakeholders.

* Ability to work independently, manage a structured sales pipeline, and demonstrate accountability for commercial outcomes.

* Availability to support US business hours depending on the hiring organization's requirements.



Industry experience is a strict requirement. General B2B sales, SaaS sales, real estate sales, insurance sales, retail sales, and other sales backgrounds without direct staffing or recruitment industry sales experience do not meet the minimum qualifications.



Relevant Business Development & Sales Backgrounds

We welcome professionals with experience in one or more of the following areas.



New Business Development

* Staffing Business Development

* Recruitment Agency Sales

* New Client Acquisition

* Outbound Prospecting and Lead Generation

* Recruitment Service Sales



Client Relations & Account Growth

* Staffing Account Management

* Client Relationship Development

* Existing Account Expansion

* Key Account Management

* Recruitment Partnership Development



Specialized Recruitment Markets

* Technology and IT Staffing

* Healthcare and Medical Staffing

* Finance and Accounting Recruitment

* Engineering and Manufacturing Staffing

* Professional and Executive Search

* Industrial, Logistics, and Commercial Staffing



Candidates are not expected to have experience in every area listed. We are primarily interested in the depth of your staffing and recruitment sales experience, your familiarity with the US market, and your ability to contribute to client acquisition and business growth.



What We Value

* Industry knowledge: A practical understanding of how staffing and recruitment firms acquire clients, generate job orders, and develop profitable business relationships.

* Commercial judgment: The ability to identify genuine business opportunities, qualify prospective clients, and prioritize accounts with meaningful growth potential.

* Prospecting expertise: Confidence in reaching decision makers, initiating commercial conversations, and developing relationships with prospective clients.

* Professional communication: Clear and credible conversations with hiring leaders, business owners, and recruitment decision makers.

* Ownership and consistency: Disciplined pipeline management, reliable follow through, and accountability for sales activity and business development results.

* Relationship development: The ability to establish trust, understand client priorities, and maintain productive commercial relationships.



Compensation

Compensation will vary based on the hiring organization, position, relevant staffing and recruitment sales experience, US market exposure, and demonstrated commercial performance. Depending on the opportunity, compensation may include a fixed base salary, performance incentives, commissions, or a combination of these components. Specific compensation details will be discussed when a suitable opportunity becomes available.



Employment Structure

Alderstone Partners connects experienced professionals with staffing and recruitment firms for potential direct employment. When a suitable opportunity becomes available, qualified professionals may be contacted to discuss the position, hiring organization, compensation structure, and employment requirements before proceeding.

Successful candidates will be employed directly by the hiring organization, not Alderstone Partners.



Alderstone Partners facilitates candidate assessment, professional introductions, and hiring coordination. The hiring organization retains responsibility for its recruitment decisions and employment arrangements.



Important Information About Your Application

This posting is intended to identify and engage qualified professionals for Alderstone Partners' growing talent network. It does not represent an immediate opening or guarantee an interview, employment offer, or placement. Applications will be reviewed based on relevant staffing and recruitment industry sales experience, professional background, market exposure, and potential alignment with future client requirements. Qualified candidates may be contacted as suitable opportunities become available. Any introduction to a prospective hiring organization will be discussed with the candidate beforehand.



If you have direct business development or sales experience within the staffing and recruitment industry, we welcome your application and the opportunity to learn more about your background.

title: Amazon Supervisor
description:
Amazon Supervisor



Work Setup: Remote / Work From Home  

Department: Amazon Operations  

Reports To: Amazon Manager



About the Role



We are looking for an experienced Amazon Supervisor to oversee daily Amazon operations and ensure the team consistently delivers accurate, efficient, and high-quality work.



The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of Amazon Seller Central, product listing management, FBA inventory, account health, sales performance, and advertising metrics. This person will supervise daily workflows, monitor team performance, resolve operational issues, and coordinate with other departments to keep Amazon operations running smoothly.



You will work closely with the Amazon Manager to execute business strategies, improve operational efficiency, and support the company's continued growth in the Amazon marketplace.



Key Responsibilities



1. Amazon Store & Listing Management

- Supervise the creation, maintenance, and optimization of Amazon product listings.

- Ensure product titles, bullet points, descriptions, images, A+ content, pricing, and variations are accurate and updated.

- Monitor listing quality, keyword optimization, organic rankings, and catalog performance.

- Identify and resolve listing errors, suppressed listings, and catalog issues.

- Ensure listing updates and optimization tasks are completed accurately and on time.



2. Sales & Performance Monitoring

- Monitor daily and weekly sales, traffic, conversion rates, and overall store performance.

- Track sales performance against targets and identify underperforming products.

- Coordinate the implementation of approved promotions, deals, coupons, and pricing updates.

- Analyze sales trends and recommend opportunities to improve product visibility and conversions.

- Prepare regular performance reports and provide actionable insights to the Amazon Manager.



3. Inventory & FBA Operations

- Monitor FBA inventory levels, stock availability, and inventory health.

- Coordinate with Supply Chain and inventory planning teams on replenishment requirements.

- Identify potential stockouts, excess inventory, aged inventory, and stranded inventory.

- Follow up on inventory-related concerns and ensure timely resolution.

- Help maintain healthy inventory levels and product availability across Amazon marketplaces.



4. Amazon Account Health & Compliance

- Monitor Account Health, policy notifications, listing suppressions, and other account-related issues.

- Ensure compliance with Amazon policies, marketplace requirements, and internal procedures.

- Coordinate the resolution of account performance issues, listing violations, and customer-related concerns.

- Manage follow-ups on cases submitted to Amazon Seller Support.

- Escalate critical account risks, policy violations, and potential suspensions to the Amazon Manager.



5. Advertising & Campaign Monitoring

- Monitor Amazon PPC campaigns and advertising performance in coordination with the responsible team.

- Review advertising metrics, including ACOS, ROAS, TACOS, and ad-driven sales.

- Track campaign budgets, keyword performance, and opportunities for optimization.

- Coordinate approved campaign adjustments and promotional activities.

- Identify underperforming campaigns and communicate recommendations to the Amazon Manager.



6. Team Supervision & Workflow Management

- Supervise daily team activities, task assignments, priorities, and deadlines.

- Monitor individual productivity, work quality, and adherence to established procedures.

- Review completed tasks to ensure accuracy and consistency.

- Provide guidance, coaching, and constructive feedback to team members.

- Follow up on pending tasks and ensure deliverables are completed on schedule.

- Identify recurring operational problems and recommend process improvements.

- Promote accountability, clear communication, and continuous improvement within the team.



7. Reporting & Cross-Department Coordination

- Prepare and maintain regular reports, trackers, and documentation related to Amazon operations.

- Coordinate with Supply Chain, Product Development, Marketing, and other relevant departments.

- Communicate operational concerns, delays, and performance trends to the Amazon Manager.

- Track action items and ensure timely follow-up across departments.

- Recommend improvements to workflows, reporting, and day-to-day operations.



Qualifications & Requirements



- Proven experience in Amazon Seller Central and e-commerce operations.

- Previous experience in a supervisory, team lead, or operations leadership role 

- Strong understanding of Amazon product listing management, catalog maintenance, and listing optimization.

- Experience with FBA inventory management, replenishment coordination, and inventory health monitoring.

- Familiarity with Amazon Account Health, policy compliance, and Seller Support cases.

- Knowledge of Amazon PPC advertising and metrics such as ACOS, ROAS, and TACOS.

- Ability to analyze sales reports, identify performance trends, and recommend operational improvements.

- Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- Ability to manage multiple tasks, meet deadlines, and supervise team deliverables.

- Proficiency in spreadsheets, reporting tools, and e-commerce management systems.

- Comfortable working independently in a remote environment while coordinating with a distributed team.



 What We’re Looking For



- A hands-on leader who can manage daily operations while maintaining high standards of accuracy and quality.

- Someone who takes ownership of tasks, follows through on commitments, and holds the team accountable.

- A proactive problem-solver who can identify issues before they become major operational concerns.

- A detail-oriented individual who is comfortable working with data, reports, and performance metrics.

- A collaborative team player who can coordinate effectively with management and other departments.



 How to Apply



If you have experience in Amazon operations and enjoy leading a team, improving processes, and supporting e-commerce growth, we would love to hear from you.



Please submit your updated resume highlighting your relevant Amazon experience, leadership responsibilities, and key accomplishments.

title: Senior AI-First Airbnb Operations VA
description:
Luxora (StayLuxora) · Full time, 40 hours/week · Remote, U.S. Eastern hours



ABOUT LUXORA

Luxora (StayLuxora) runs 280+ short-term rental units across Philadelphia and Dallas. We lease apartment buildings and operate them as furnished stays, mostly booked through Airbnb. Day-to-day operations run through a remote VA team working with local cleaning and maintenance teams in both cities.



We also build our own operations software, and AI is already part of how we work. We're hiring a senior VA who works the same way.



THE ROLE

You'll handle guest communication and daily operations across our portfolio, using Claude and ChatGPT throughout the day to do it faster and better. You'll also help us build agentic workflows that take repetitive work off the team.



AI drafts, you decide. We need someone who can tell when an AI answer is wrong, when a guest needs a real person, and when to escalate.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

A self-starter who takes initiative and doesn't need to be told what to work on next. You notice gaps in how the business runs and bring a fix, like a guest question that keeps getting answered from scratch or a report someone rebuilds by hand every week. When you see work being done manually, you look for a way to automate it and you're willing to build it yourself.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Guest communication

• Reply to guest messages in Guesty and Airbnb before, during and after each stay. Slow or missed replies are the biggest driver of bad reviews for us, so speed matters.

• Handle check-in and access issues, Wi-Fi, house rules, booking changes, cancellations, and early check-in, late checkout, pet and parking requests.

• Calm down unhappy guests and fix the problem before it becomes a bad review, including refunds within our guidelines.

• Answer questions about our Damage Protection Program and other fees, and apply our waiver policy.

• Ask guests who had a great stay to leave a review.



Reviews and Airbnb

• Track review scores at the unit level and flag units that are slipping.

• Respond to reviews and work with Airbnb Support on removal requests for reviews that break Airbnb policy.

• Handle Resolution Center cases and damage claims.



Operations

• Dispatch and follow up on cleaning and maintenance issues with our local teams until they're closed.

• Keep listings, check-in guides and unit details (door codes, Wi-Fi, instructions) accurate.

• Keep our Notion workspace current: tasks, maintenance tracker, SOPs.

• Pull daily and weekly reports on guest issues, reviews and unit performance.



AI and agentic workflows

• Use Claude and ChatGPT every day to draft guest replies, summarize long threads, analyze review and reservation data in Google Sheets, and write SOPs.

• Build and maintain the knowledge our AI tools work from: property details, house rules, policies, prompt libraries, Claude Projects and custom GPTs.

• Help build and run agentic workflows in Claude and ChatGPT (connectors, MCP, agents) for routine steps like inbox triage, flagging at-risk stays, logging issues to Notion and sending daily reports.

• Spot repetitive work, propose how to automate it, and document what you build so the rest of the team can use it.

• Review AI output before it reaches a guest. Protect guest data and logins, and never paste passwords or API keys into AI tools.



TOOLS WE USE

Airbnb, VRBO, Guesty, HostOp (our in-house platform), Stripe, PriceLabs, Notion, Monday.com, Google Workspace, Claude, ChatGPT.



You don't need every one on day one. You do need to have worked inside a PMS (Guesty preferred) and be comfortable in Google Sheets and Notion.



MUST HAVE

• 3+ years in short-term rental guest communication or operations, with Airbnb as a main channel

• A self-starter who spots gaps and manual work and fixes or automates them without being asked

• Daily use of Claude and ChatGPT in real work, with examples you can show

• Hands-on experience with at least one agentic or automation setup: Claude Code, Claude with connectors or MCP, custom GPTs with actions, Make or Zapier with AI steps, or an AI agent you've built or run

• Excellent written English that reads warm and natural, not scripted

• Good judgment on when to fix, when to refund and when to escalate

• Comfortable in Google Sheets: filters, formulas, pivot tables

• Reliable internet with a backup connection and backup power

• Available full time on U.S. Eastern hours (Philippine night shift)



NICE TO HAVE

• Experience at Airbnb Support or with a property manager running 100+ units

• PriceLabs or Stripe experience

• Basic understanding of APIs, webhooks and JSON

• Experience writing SOPs and training other VAs



WHAT WE OFFER

• Full-time, long-term role

• Team bonuses tied to portfolio review scores

• Raises based on performance reviews

• A team that is building AI into every part of its operations



HOW TO APPLY

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph only. Your application must include all of the following:



1. Start your message with "LUXORA AI" so we know you read the full post.

2. Your resume (PDF).

3. A 3 to 5 minute screen-share video (Loom, or unlisted YouTube or Google Drive) walking us through one real AI workflow you use or built in Claude, ChatGPT or another AI tool. Show it working and explain what it saves you.

4. Your reply to the guest message below, plus 2 to 3 lines on what you'd do behind the scenes. Use AI the way you normally would, and include the share link to the chat or the prompt you used.

   "Hi, the door code you sent isn't working. We've been outside for 25 minutes with two kids and it's 11pm. If we're not inside in 10 minutes I want a full refund."

5. In 3 to 5 sentences: one agentic workflow you would build in your first 30 days for a 280-unit Airbnb operation, and which tools you'd use.

6. In 3 to 5 sentences: a manual process you noticed in a past role and fixed or automated on your own initiative. What was it, what did you build, and what did it save?

7. A screenshot of your internet speed test.



Applications missing any of these won't be reviewed.
